1.Title: Temple of Time
1.Story:
"Halcyon Quicksand" is a faction of the Order of the Sun that is proficient in time-magic. They can enter the Time Corridor (a realm beyond the dimension of reality) invisible to laymen, and search the vast ocean of fragmented histories for clues to those ancient magics submerged in the mire of history.
Throughout Esperia's long history, many heroes have come and gone, but one thing they share in common is that they stood out from the crowd, like a star, shining brighter than all the others. With mastery over time-magic, the mages of Halcyon Quicksand can step into the flowing river of history and, relying on special beacons to locate time fragments in which heroes lived, restore said heroes so that their glory may shine once more in the present day.

1.Title: Blooming Wishes
1.Story:
In the sweet wedding of the couple led out of the forest by deer, the bride threw flowers picked from the forest to the guests who came to wish them happiness, hoping the one who caught them would be as happy as they were.
    The young man who caught the flowers amidst the lively uproar also received sincere blessings from people. Perhaps infected by the sweet atmosphere, he became absorbed in skillfully weaving the flowers into a bracelet.
    He passed the crowed and went straight through the gates of happiness, running all the way, letting the breeze blow by him until he arrived at a small house, where a girl with a smile as beautiful as a flower lived.
    Panting, the young man knocked on the door. Before the girl could react, he grabbed her wrist and ran all the way to the nearby forest. The girl was taken aback by the young man, but lifted the hem of her skirt to run with him. She was full of curiosity and affection, her eyes fixed on his back.
    The young man had reached the forest, and even with a deep breath could not contain himself. He held up the rudimentary bracelet he had made himself, and said dryly "look!"
    The girl's rosy face was more beautiful than the flowers. She seemed to know what was about to happen, as she had a slightly expecting smile. The young man couldn't think straight, but managed to ask loudly "Will you spend the rest of your life with me?"
    From then on, lovers often used the flowers they received from weddings to make such bracelets for each other in the hope that their love would last. Nowadays, people also use their own flower bracelets to thank the people who have helped them and to pray for a happy and fulfilling life.

 ——Gretel Hawke

1.Title: Forest Sonnets
1.Story:
Legend has it a long, long time ago, a pair of lovers went to the forest in anger at their families' opposition to their love, but they were unable to find their way out for a long time. They were desperate, but they snuggled together under an ancient tree and made the decision "If we can never find a way out, we'll simply live here".
    There was however, a miraculous turn of events. Deep from within in the dark forest came a beautiful doe, her whole body seemed bathed in light as it looked at them with bright, gentle eyes.
    They looked long and hard at the doe, obviously of a different species, but they could see the emotions hid behind those serene eyes, as if the mother of life was blessing her child to be happy forever.
    The beautiful doe then raised her head slightly as if to greet them, and turned away slowly to leave. The tip of her nose touched a branch that was growing sideways, bending the wildflower that grew from it. The two finally left the forest guided of the doe, and the girl took pity on the broken flower, so she picked it and carried it with her.
    They came out of the forest as if blessed by the gods. They reconciled with their families, full of affection and trust despite their troubles along the way, and the lovers eventually went together to the temple of happiness.
    Their meeting of the magical doe in the forest was announced at their wedding, and all those told thought it a miracle, and as time passed in gradually turned to legend: If two lovers go into the forest hand-in-hand and see a beautiful doe and return with the first flower it touches, their love will be blessed by the gods.
    Though the legend can no longer be traced back to its origin, when you think about it, the forest must signify a predicament, and the doe the determination of the two to spend the rest of their lives together.
    And nothing else matters, the most important thing is that the two join hands, hoping for a better future, and to overcome all unknowns the future holds.

 ——Gretel Hawke

1.Title: Poetic Pop Quiz
1.Story:
Adventurers have journeyed long and far, memories still fresh.
 
Why not put your knowledge to the test?
 
Does one know enough about the rules?
 
Does one know all the stories of the realm?
 
Many answers may be hidden in songs.
 
The farther one travels, the more knowledge they shall accrue.
 
Test your knowledge, there may be a little something waiting for you.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Story: The Tulip Poetry Circle is a social group of bards, musicians and other artists located within Oakenfell. The artists in the poetry society would take to the streets from time to time, reciting heroic epics and rural legends, also finding new material and inspirations to compose new poems from those they met on the streets of Oakenfell. Most of the art that the Tulip Poetry Circle create can be traced back to historical deeds that took truly took place.

1.Title: Nightmare's Emergence
1.Story:
In the dark depths of the Dreamrealm, a Hypogean breaks free of the seal that binds him in place. Dreams and reality alike are both corroded by the influence he holds over them. Writhing and twitching within the Twisted Realm, ominous nightmares brood, planning their descent into Esperia.
    Valiant Dream Divers, heed Tasi's call, venture into the Twisted Realm and engage the ominous nightmares within. Defeat the evil entities one by one, and the dark enveloping mist shall be dispersed, to reveal the true face of evil.

1.Title: Gear Resonance
1.Story:
They say that on the battlefield, your closest comrades are not your brothers-in-arms, nor your horse, but something more easily overlooked and much closer to you - your armor.

It protects your body, sharing your blood-soaked fights, reveling with you in victory. Yet heed me now, even when your prayers to the gods fall on deaf ears, your armor shall still be there to protect you.

And so from plight to plight, the armor you possess grows in quantity, each piece a symbol of your glory, each crack and tear a silent scar of loyalty to you.

When this loyalty becomes strong, so strong that all battle armor resonates as one, their souls are awakened. The physical realm is transcended, making sharp weapons sharper and protective gear stronger.

This resonance will accompany you in your upcoming campaigns, derived from your existence, becoming your strength.

I'm not the first person to discover this, and I certainly won't be the last.

1.Title: Lost Grace
1.Story:
Before the dance began, I argued with Prince Lester. I wanted that Rayne family apparel, but Lester denied it to me.
    Following the death of dearest friend, Baden Rayne, the apparel had never again been donned. As more Rayne Family men passed away, either in battle or of advancing age, the family numbers dwindled, and the apparel came to remain with the royal court simply because there was no longer an heir to claim it. However, there is now an heir apparent, and the apparel should be duly returned to its rightful owner. Thus, I took this opportunity to visit my hometown of Oakenfell, which I had long been absent from, using the dance as my justification, hoping that I would be able to restore the apparel to the Rayne family.
    We argued for a while and despite his refusal, much to my surprise he came to change his mind and granted me permission to take the apparel. However, it was under the condition I do for him one thing... Steal it before the dance began. It had to be stolen before the dance began, and he would not make it easy for me.
    I didn't really understand, but he told me, "It's an opportunity."
    He divulged that he was looking for an excuse to investigate the instability within Oakenfell, that the theft of the apparel was the perfect cover. A fine opportunity to be rid of these 'unstable elements', as he called them. To test for weak links in the city's defenses. If I could indeed take the apparel from within the city walls, then it proved the city's defenses needed further reinforcement.
    I had no desire to steal anything, but I was more than willing to acquiesce to the Prince's wishes in order to get the Rayne Family apparel back where it belonged.
    So, the day of the dance I patrolled the Manor, checking for gaps in the security. It wasn't long before I noticed a figure skulking in the shadows. I recognized him in short order - Kren, a wanted Mauler. I was sure he'd come here with ill intent, but thought I might yet make use of him as a distraction, seizing it as my opportunity to steal the apparel.
    I cast a stone at the bush inside which Kren was hiding himself, forcing him to move and thus alert the nearby guards to his presence. While they turned their attention to him, I took the apparel from within the room. To get the apparel out of the city, I had already devised a plan.
    Parked outside the Manor I noticed the Earl's carriage, the Earl who conveniently lives outside the city. While I was patrolling, I saw the Earl's butler exit the vehicle and extend his congratulatory wishes to the Prince. While the carriage was left unsupervised, I secured the apparel to the underside of it, well-hidden, knowing the carriage would soon be departing from the city. Since the carriage would not be subjected to the mandatory guard inspections owing to the Earl's status, I knew the apparel would not be discovered. Upon intercepting the carriage outside of the city walls, I could recover the apparel from the bottom of the carriage and the guards would be able to corroborate my story that I left the city carrying nothing on my person.
    Everything was going according to plan, right until the last moment, when things took a sudden turn. Moments before the carriage departed, Kren snuck his way under the carriage, using it to depart the city. Fearing the apparel may be taken, I pursued them the whole way, hurrying to catch up. I only managed to intercept the vehicle once it had returned to the Earl's Manor. I told the Earl's butler that I suspected someone was hiding underneath the carriage, taking the opportunity to check the underside. Fortunately, the apparel was still there, yet Kren was long since gone, so it seemed he had not discovered it.
    After the apparel's loss, the Prince took the opportunity to put the whole city under martial law and search it house by house, so I think those 'unstable elements' of Oakenfell are presumably now under the Prince's control... I don't agree with his methods, but understand his intent. Oakenfell is not the paragon of virtue and purity it seems to be. Even now, the Hypogean are never far from us, perhaps they are closer than we realize, pretending to be our friends. When one is in a position of authority, one must be even more vigilant, especially of those one keeps close. It is for us to protect the peace we fought hard for, for the stability of our lives. We mustn't allow the memory and glories of our ancestors to fade into obscurity, rather, we must fan the flames of that glory in the young ones of our world today.

1.Title: Dance of Wonder
1.Story:
As dusk fell, lights twinkle and flicker
The lonely maiden puts on her magnificent dress
Her graceful posture, a prelude to a solitary dance
Such stunning beauty begins to move to the beat
 
Once the happy wife of a god
Later a grieving mother, unable to care for her son
No more is she bound to her old self
With your thorny bouquet in tow,
She steps into a world of vengeance
 
Her youth is in full bloom
In the middle of the empty dance floor below
Her feet move, as she flows
A way of safeguarding her freedom, or finding her own salvation
No one knows

1.Title: Ravishing Roses
1.Story:
It has been a long lasting custom for people to gift flowers to girl they admire before this traditional dance begins, as a way of expressing their admiration of beauty.
And making beautiful bouquets out of fresh flowers is a way of passing on one's blessings to another.
Admiration is not only prescribed to a beloved's beauty, just as a rose represents more than love.
These gifted roses are a tribute, a tribute to one's dance, and one's freedom.

1.Title: Disaster's Emergence
1.Story:
Even before the festivities could end, a crisis was brewing in the distance. While the citizens of Esperia were indulging in celebrations, a dormant danger began to spread its roots throughout the land. Pestilence and disaster enveloped the land from all sides. Perhaps a premonition of even greater disasters to come, as these are the ill omens that first arose from feathered dreams, and later came to fruition...
    When disasters strike, a hero shines. With such pressing matters facing the realm of Esperia, heroes must once again embark on a journey and step into the fray, weaving new historical records as they venture forward.

1.Title: Winds of Change
1.Story:
Thane is a talented swordsman from Oakenfell. He lost an arm through his own reckless actions while serving in the military.
After being saved by his best friend, he swore to protect the members of their house.
When the catastrophe came,
the swordsman embarked once more on a journey to save the heir of the house.
A journey to find the Elemental Guardian.
With the blessings of the Wind, Thane's swordsmanship has reached a new level.
Before the wind could carry the sound of his blade being drawn, his sword would already be at his enemy's throat.
Thane shall never stop until all catastrophes end.

1.Title: Echoes of Time
1.Story:
This volume stands out among its countless peers in the library. Scholars filled its endless pages with myths and legends of this land, documenting the course of history.
    This volume has infinite pages, without a beginning or an end. Every chapter represents a fleeting moment in history. Heroes of yore are no more, but their stories are documented for future generations to witness. The rustle as your fingertip brushes against the paper seems to be whispering, telling about people and places that are long forgotten.

1.Title: Nightmare's Emergence
1.Story:
Esperians are familiar with the name Ezizh, the demon that sows nightmares. But few know that the demon is only one apparition of many, while its true self burrows in the Twisted Realm, waiting for the opportunity to break into the reality. The Guardian of Dreams won't allow that, however. Tasi and her Dream Divers managed to trap Ezizh in the Twisted Realm, while its apparitions haunt dreams of mortals to keep it nourished.
    
    Now Ezizh is out of hibernation. With streams of power coursing through its body, it breaks free from the limbo, ready to claim the reality. It leaps from one nightmare to another, looking for the perfect foundation to build upon, to smother Esperia in desperation.
    
    Tasi, aware of the throbbing of nightmares, tried to thwart Ezizh's plan in dreams. But with Ezizh's elevated power, the best Tasi could do was to distract him. A game of cat and mouse began, through one dream after another, wonderous or grotesque.
    
    Just when Ezizh was about to capture Tasi, the duo stumbled into a horrendous nightmare, one where Esperia crumbles among disasters, vile creatures, and wars. It was the end of the world.
    
    Ezizh was thrilled. It was the most terrible nightmare that he was looking for. He left Tasi alone, shifting his attention to the dreamer instead. He must find the source of the nightmare and expand it into the reality.
    
    Tasi was terrified, because she knew the dreamer. Talene, the last successor of the Obsidian Finches. That reminds her of an unsettling rumor, that Celestials don't dream, unless it's an omen. This looks very much like an ill omen.
    
    But really, what does it mean?

1.Title: Winds of Change
1.Story:
In the Land of the Exiles, Thane endured the throbbing pain in his arm and swung his sword at the creature before him. Sweat and blood blurred his vision, and exhaustion was eroding his will, inch by inch. But he could not fall, for his best friend was behind him, and once he fell, Baden would be overwhelmed.
    
    During his journey with Talene and others in search of the Elemental Guardian, Thane encountered Baden in the Land of the Exiles. Baden and Respen suddenly found themselves surrounded by Corruptors. There was no time to catch up after years of separation. Thane and his party immediately joined the battle and fought side by side with Baden. Faced with a constant onslaught of Corruptors, the only way to survive is to eliminate the enemy.
    
    Despite the years of separation, they still understood each other as tacitly as they did on the battlefield back then, needing merely a glance for the other to comprehend their intentions. The pair attacked and defended methodically, breaking through the horde of Corruptors. Yet, as the circle shrank, the men were scattered by the surge of Corruptors, and Thane and Baden, the best of friends, became islands in a sea of aggression. The pair relied on each other to defend against the threats at their backs.
    
    Thane had no idea how many times he swung his sword, the corpses of the Corruptors piled high on the scorching yellow sand. Yet the Corruptors, like a frenzied ant colony, tirelessly lashed out their claws and teeth at the two men, and for every one that fell, there were still more monsters trampling over the bodies of their companions to fill the breach. They were exhausted from the fierce battle thus far, and could only force their numb bodies to hold on with the determination not to collapse. Through all endless killing, the duo had spent the last of their energy.
    
    Thane finally reached his limit, his body tottering, unable to fight against the advancing Corruptors. A spear with serrated teeth swept away the creatures around him, allowing Thane a brief respite. The only thing he saw through blurred vision was Baden holding off the Corruptors with his mangled frame, holding the spear across his chest and screaming for Thane to retreat.
    
    The look in Baden's eyes made Thane's heart burn, the expression in his best friend's eyes was as determined as when he died to save him, even though he knew the road ahead was dangerous, he was still ready to die. In that battle, he lost his arm, and his best friend lost his life trying to protect him. Now, the tragedy that he had regretted for half his life was about to repeat itself.
    
    Thane could not allow himself to watch his best friend die for him a second time. He resented his powerlessness, but he was too exhausted to grip his sword. Staring at his friend's back, Thane made a decisive stand. He sought the power of the Elemental Emblem from Respen, and although this would come at a great cost - becoming the Corruptors' target for the rest of his journey - he had no time to care about anything else. He was willing to pay any price if he could save his best friend.
    
    "I won't let this happen again!"
    
    The intangible winds converged in Thane's hands, the wind Wind Emblem fused with his body, and a surge of power rose up within him. Thane once again gripped the sword in his hand and swung with all his strength.
    A hurricane borne of the sword's tip, a blade of wind burst into the sky, and everything before him was enveloped in howling gusts. The sword blade broke free of the gale and furiously pierced the Corruptor in front of Baden.
    
    "This time, we fight side by side, together!"

1.Title: Chapter 1 Rising Winds
1.Story:
Ill omens first arose from feathered dreams
Warning Esperia of impending crisis
 
Among celebrations did such nightmares come to pass
 
As Rayne's female general fell with sickness
So a solitary one-armed soldier did set forth
 
In the Dark Forest fates mingled and merged
As divine bird and human warrior didst meet
 
The forest sage spoke freely of all things
And the truth behind disaster came to light
 
In the beginning,
Five elements together founded Esperia
 
Thus elemental imbalance creates catastrophe
And turns the world upside down
 
Only the combined power of the five Elemental Guardians
Can restore elemental order and avert disaster
 
Above golden sands they meet once more
The undead knight is surrounded on all sides
 
Wind's blessing of the swordsman grants tremendous might
And thus begins a new chapter in our tale

1.Title: The Anguished
1.Story:
It was just as my dreams had foretold. The temple where the tormented goddess was being held lay at the foot of the mountain range. I stood where the setting sun could be seen, shining through a crevice, and observed the unfolding scene.
    —Rather than call it a temple, perhaps it's better to describe it as a tower without doors.
    I recalled my dreams, depicting the scene within the temple: the divine goddess shackled to the wall by the Hypogean, sharp spikes driven through her wings, horrifying streaks of blood.
    She told me of her agony, that her name was Vyloris, and that she had been deceived into leaving the safety of her mountain top and descending unto this place of pain. Bewitched and beguiled by the Hypogean, her captors have since tortured and tormented her without end, all to drain every drop of divine power from her.
    In my dream, I swore that I would save her before darkness enveloped all. I would defeat the Hypogean holding her captive, and deliver her from suffering.
    Under the brilliance of a rising full moon I found the loathsome Hypogean, drew my weapon and attacked. No expression could be discerned on the fiend's foul, mangled face, but he clearly hesitated—as if he wished to speak.
    A repugnant whooshing noise came from his throat. I understand not the Hypogean language, nor did I want my determination to be undermined, so I raised again my sword and struck fiercely.
     The outcome of our mortal fight was uncertain, but victory ultimately fell to me. It was with the purest joy that I plunged my blade deep into the beast's chest. The bright red blood which spurted from his fatal wound seemed identical to mine.
    Right then, I was so tired I felt like I could barely stand.
    But I mustered the last of my strength to cleave in twain the wall to which the goddess was chained. I saw Vyloris break free from her bonds amidst the swirling dust. She smiled and walked toward me, and as she embraced me I knew that everything I had done was worth the effort.
    Just then, the gentle and caressing hand of the goddess on my chest transformed into a razor-sharp claw. Black light enveloped me, as every inch of both armor and flesh disintegrated under that terrible claw.
    It was soul-light, the light of the Infernal Surge.
     "What a just and handsome knight you are, just like the previous pitiful wretch... The one you just defeated." I screamed, eyes wide in fear and pain as I watched her slash my face and cut out my tongue with keen-edged blades. "I'd really hate to kill you. You don't foolishly think, like him, that chaining me up in a temple could possibly seal a demoness?" 
    I looked at the limp figure on the ground, of the "Hypogean" I had just slaughtered. I tried to call for help, but nothing but a hideous whooshing noise emerged.
    I finally realized what he was trying to tell me. But I could only howl in frustration and regret—that mangled, hideous face was only so because of the inhuman torture inflicted upon it.
    Night fell, and I had not defeated the true Hypogean. All too soon, my eyesight was taken from me. I was left with but a poor sense of hearing as, accompanied by Vyloris' joyful humming, I fell into total darkness.

      "Lies are intoxicating, because people only believe what they want to believe."

1.Title: Treasure Scramble
1.Story:
Hey! Treasure hunter, are you also planning to vie for the treasures buried in a corner of this domain?
 
Don't look at me like that! I don't care where you got the information, whether it was picked up in a tavern or pried out of the mouth of some unlucky fool, it has no bearing on the people gathered here that you're going to be dealing with.
 
As an experienced treasure hunter, I would like to remind you that once you set foot on the road, all the spoils will be at your fingertips! However, only by defeating your rivals on the road will you be qualified to compete for the title that signifies the highest rank of treasure hunter. These competitors on the same path as you are bad news, becoming stumbling blocks in your journey. Of course, if you are strong enough, their bodies will form your ladder to victory! You will tread in the blood of the defeated, to harvest the rich fruits and glory that belong to you!
 
Haha, take it easy! I just want to give you a little advice - choose the right route, bring your strongest, most trustworthy teammates, and forge ahead!
 
On the way, there may be extreme weather, or harsh environments. With constant, random encounters on the way, you need to push your limits to defeat your foes, otherwise you're just a sitting duck!
 
And next, good luck!

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Story: A faction's sigil is much more than just a trinket. It is a symbol imbued with great meaning, a physical representation of the faction's honor, its accomplishments, its integrity. Though a sigil is always heavily guarded, the chaos of conflict can scatter even the most precious treasures to the wind. In order to restore the honor of their factions, heroes from across the realm will set out to gather the lost sigils, facing impossible odds and hundreds of pitfalls along the way.

1.Title: 追剿试炼
1.Story:
In the deep recesses of the Temporal Rift, a hidden and peculiar aura lurks. The spawning of strong and chaotic monstrosities has given rise to a subversive and twisted force that now dwells here. These pernicious beings detest all things that represent space and order. Here, chaos is uncontested and reigns supreme. If these creatures were to sally forth in full strength, fixing this chaotic turbulence would become an even greater, and arduous task to undertake.
    On their journey to repair the Temporal Rift, brave adventurers made use of the Dimensional Gate crafted by Celestial Craftsman, Ansiel, as they dove head first into the den of scurrying fiends.
    What awaits them shall be a battle of both courage and perseverance. Only warriors who have tested their mettle dare enter this domain.

1.Title: The Celestial Isles
1.Story: The strange cubes found upon the celestial isles were created by Ansiel, the Heavenly Crafter. They were used to keep the celestial artifacts from the hands of those with evil intent. Meticulously crafted from ethereal energies made tangible, they are as intricate as they are secure. Each cube consists of multiple parts that twist and rearrange into protective patterns that give way only to a celestial key. Acquiring something so valuable as a celestial key, however, is far from an easy task.

1.Title: Celestial Offerings
1.Story: "If both eyes are veiled by the mist, heed your heart. Allow the will of the gods to guide you to the gifts hidden amongst the stones." —Gretel Hawke, Esperian Records of the Bizarre.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Story: The Tulip Poetry Circle is a social group of bards, musicians and other artists located within Oakenfell. The artists in the poetry society would take to the streets from time to time, reciting heroic epics and rural legends, also finding new material and inspirations to compose new poems from those they met on the streets of Oakenfell. Most of the art that the Tulip Poetry Circle create can be traced back to historical deeds that took truly took place.

1.Title: A Flame Reborn
1.Story:
Talene, the last surviving bloodline of the Obsidian Finch species. Her flame flickers and wavers deep within the dark depths of the forest, meanwhile a thick, icy haze slowly devours what little light remains in the forest, threatening to completely snuff it out. Before her, a ferocious purplish-red flame rages wildly, as if wanting to devour all in its path. The manifestation of a nefarious, grinning demon has appeared within the flame. It was this very kind of flame that had previously made Talene lose all hope as a youngling. Despair once again looms closer.
    
    "Talene... Talene... Hurry, wake up..."
    While in a trance, Talene could seemingly hear her mother's distant call. In the deepest reaches of her memory, it was there she found her. A manifestation of her mother appeared before Talene's own eyes, enveloped by blazing, demonic flames. Talene reached out to grasp her mother, but after a few short seconds she would watch her fade into the ether. With a furrowed brow and trembling arms, Talene struggles with her inner turmoil, struggling in vain to wake herself from the deep memories that entrance her. That ominous flame draws closer...
    
    "Talene... Astar will protect you..."
    Dazed, Talene sees yet another scene unfurl before her. Astar looked back worryingly at Talene as she steeled her resolve, and with a look of determination on her face, dove into the sea of fire.
    
    Talene could not allow herself to sink into despair again. Both her eyes flickered open, a pure fire burning fiercely within them as she burst upward out of the forest. Golden embers flitted in her wake, piercing the enveloping darkness! The Solaris Flare can never be extinguished and shall forever continue to burn. Its pure fire can be rekindled from its fallen embers. The Obsidian Finch soars toward Esperia in a new form, a new legend is about to be written.

1.Title: The Desert Affliction
1.Story:
The elements within Esperia have lost their equilibrium. Now, not only is the Lightbearer Empire afflicted by unusual scarring creatures and natural disasters, but having slowly sprawled across the continent, they have begun to enter the Scorched Expanse. These creatures now threaten the sacred Mauler oasis known as Dura's Gift, and it is at this crucial period of time that Brutus, the Blood Claw must depart Paragon's Peak.
        At the same time, the divine bird and her companions who are burdened with the task of balancing the elements, have also stepped into the golden sands of the expanse.

1.Title: The Mauler Will
1.Story:
The lion titled The Blood Claw has yet to accept the title.
His mentor's defection tarnished the title Blood Claw,
his inherited cape and crown, thrown to the wayside.
For many years, his search for his mentor continued without interruption,
until he would finally face his mentor atop the golden sands.
The battle ends, and with it so does their animosity.
With crown and cape adorned, he sets out on his journey.
He now assumes his position as the true Blood Claw, sworn to protect his tribe's future.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Story:
Ladies and gentlemen! With the sun shining brightly, what a great time for the Megamouth Shark Troupe to once again go on tour!
    Get ready to bear witness to Oakenfell's most extraordinary performers and magicians! There's no other people or place which can wow you.
    During our tour, we'll also be holding a competition! Defeat the performers and receive a special, bespoke Megamouth Shark Troupe reward for your efforts, as long as you collect it in person.
    Don't miss this amazing opportunity, you might just regret it!

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Story: Periodically, the Megamouth Shark Troupe will tour the Royal capital Savannah for half a month. These packed tours attract people from all over sending ticket prices skyrocketing. Performances include knife juggling, fire-breathing, trapeze artists and the ever-thrilling Magic Hat trick.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Story:
The Megamouth Shark Troupe is Oakenfell's resident Circus Troupe. They hold big performances three times a month and every one is a sell-out show.
    As well as performing in Oakenfell, the Troupe also travels the world putting on shows. The Megamouth Shark Troupe has brought laughter to every corner of Esperia, and the Troupe's Mr Wake has collected innumerable goodies from all over the world.
    Only the Megamouth Shark Troupe's most loyal audience members can redeem the commemorative medal for Mr Wake's exclusive treasure.

1.Title: Dune Destroyer
1.Story:
The Corruptors were born out of the Elemental imbalance. The twisted elemental powers constructed them into monsters with bizarre and appalling appearances.
    Their sole existence is to stop the Elemental Guardians, as they tirelessly hunt down bearers of Elemental Emblems, like Hyenas. Among the Corruptors, there is one giant monster named Destroyer. Its body is armored with rock and sand, its giant fists able to smash boulders with ease.

1.Title: Glorified Guilds
1.Story:
Esperia is never short of heroes throughout its long history. Once rallied together, they prevail in battles, saving the world from its turmoils. Here are held the records of outstanding teams who have fought for Esperia's peace and tranquility. They are the pioneers admired by many, and the role models for others to follow.
    When crisis befalls Esperia yet again, the departed comrades will gather under the flag, ready to sound the horn of victory once more.

1.Title: Chapter 2 Trials and Tribulations
1.Story:
Bound by duty, the heroes make tracks,
Traipsing through turbulent, riotous sands.

Earth Guardian, hidden though it stays, 
yet sits amidst a pair of duelists' fray. 

Mighty Lion sword bearer, contesting teacher turned betrayer,
Old versus young, Blood Claw grievances meet their slayer.

Once the curtain of the final act falls on the battlefield, 
the Chieftain, wise and knowing, does history's secrets now reveal. 

In time long past, Chief and Teacher did agree,
false enemy collusion to unify Mauler community.          

Lion sword bearer, by unspoken truth so deeply felt,
resolved to take up the torch, bare the flame himself.

Blade newly reborn, remolded by earth,
The Blood Claw's journey starts anew, sees its own rebirth.

1.Title: Molten Crystalline Worm Queen
1.Story:
The disasters caused by the elemental imbalance have made their first appearance in Esperia. A violent quake has awakened dormant worms deep in the underground and opened a tunnel from their realm to the surface. Soon, the spider-like worms, which carry searing crystals on their back, began their invasion of the human territories, breaking into people's homes and wreaking havoc wherever they went.
    The city guards do all they can to finally repel the hungry worms, suffering terrible losses in the process. Just as everyone thinks the day is won, a giant figure rises from the cracked earth. Its hideous head dwarfs the high city walls, as it looks down upon the pitiful humans trying futilely to resist.
    The creature is the Molten Crystalline Worm Queen, Marsha, ruler of the Underground Lair, and the "mother" of all the worms. She has been lying dormant in her barren underground chamber for far too long, and she is ravenous. Her arrival has declared that this city is now the worms' new hunting ground.
    "My children, come, enjoy this feast with me!"

1.Title: Pass
1.Story:
Brandishing his lethal blade, Brutus dispatched his final foe into the dust. Grasping his greatsword with both hands, he listened to the scout's account of how a group of wicked monsters had recently appeared near the Mauler border. They were said to have appeared out of thin air, attacking the surrounding villages and gradually becoming a threat to Mauler stability itself.
    "One more thing... That person you've been looking for was spotted in the Weatherworn Dunes."
    Brutus kept a neutral expression in the face of this unexpected news, but his eyes betrayed a glimmer of excitement.
    "Found you, Anasta."
    
    The Weatherworn Dunes lies deep within the Scorched Expanse. In this uninhabited stretch of desert, which no one rashly enters, apparently tranquil dunes conceal the lethal quicksand underneath. Yet now, on the dunes above, Brutus is locked in vicious combat, his opponent wielding a sword the height of a man. Heavy blows send sand flying as the warriors' two weapons clash again and again in the fierce desert heat.
    "I've been looking for you a long time, you Mauler traitor."
    Brutus faces none other than Anasta, his one-time mentor and former Blood Claw, she who had betrayed the Maulers before fleeing.
    It seems like so long ago now, when Brutus had inadvertently discovered proof of Anasta's collusion with the Lightbearer nobility, and led his followers to foil her plot to seize the position of the Wise One. Once the dust had settled, the various tribal chieftains, realizing that humans were their common enemy, unanimously selected Skriath as their Wise One. Under his leadership, the Maulers set forth upon a unified path, with Brutus as the Blood Claw. While still highly respected among the Maulers, the stain of Anasta's treachery undoubtedly still sullied the name of Blood Claw.
    Brutus was troubled that the name inherited from a traitor had lost its due glory. He had never fully accepted the title even within his own heart, and the historical Blood Claw cloak and crown were sealed deep within the temple and never worn.
    The traitor Anasta had disappeared, reviled and hated by all the Maulers. Yet throughout all the years, Brutus had never given up the hope of tracking down his one-time mentor. Now, today, he finally gazed once more upon her as she stood before him in the flesh.
    Even after so many years it was an oddly familiar feeling to fight with Anasta once again. While he had never before managed to best her in the past, today he was a different caliber fighter. After clashing together again and again, Brutus caught her off-balance and sent her weapon flying, before knocking her to the ground.
    Brutus advanced, his vicious blade pointed at Anasta's neck, yet did not strike. "You were never so ambitious and hungry for power. Why did you betray us? Why?!!" Anasta had no intention of replying, wishing only that he do what must be done to finish this battle.
    "TELL ME THE TRUTH!" Defeating his mentor had never been Brutus' ultimate aim. For years he had harbored suspicions about her betrayal and right now, right here, he needed to know the truth.
    "Then allow me to enlighten you..." Skriath's distant voice came to Brutus' ears as his figure slowly emerged from within the whirling, dancing sand, "...about what really happened." 
    
    The Maulers had been divided ever since the assassination of the previous Wise One. The Lightbearers had seen an opportunity to continue destabilizing the Maulers, and secretly funded the Quicksand Claws to provoke internal conflict between the tribes. The tribal leaders, for their part, were totally unaware that their strings were being pulled. They acted just as expected, tearing each other apart while the humans reaped the benefit.
    Skriath and Anasta were rare visionaries among the Maulers. They astutely identified the real reason for the fracturing of Mauler society and, after contacting each other, the two kindred spirits quickly decided to cooperate with each other.
    The two wise Maulers fully understood that the current internal strife and divisions were preventing any hope of Mauler unification, and that intestine bellicosity would do nothing but bog down the Maulers in interminable conflict. Even if they declared unity to the outside world, this would be superficial only, as the individual tribal chieftains would never actually pledge loyalty to a unified force. These chieftains had only their own self-interest in mind and, as soon as an opportunity arose, would be sure to strike for their own gain. A common enemy was needed to truly end Mauler division and bind the tribes together in common enmity. It was evident that this common enemy had to be the Lightbearers, they who had been profiting from the internal discord of the Maulers, and that an opportunity had to be created to awaken those selfish chieftains to this reality.
    So the two of them acted at odds with one another, appearing to all observers as though they were contending for the leadership. In reality, however, they were secretly formulating a careful plan, and waiting for the right time to present itself.
    Soon enough, the Lightbearers sent word via the Quicksand Claws, promising Anasta power in exchange for eradicating the threat poised by Skriath. This was just the opportunity they had been waiting for, and decided to use supposed "treachery" to expose the Lightbearer plot. Crucial to the plan was a warrior of sufficient renown and loyalty to the Maulers, who could foil Anasta's "plot" before assuming the mantle of Blood Claw. In this way they could command their warriors to pledge allegiance to the Wise One.
    Brutus was just such a warrior.
    Brutus did not disappoint. Everything went according to plan, and the Maulers finally edged closer to unity. Anasta disappeared behind the scenes, as arranged by Skriath, until the Earth Guardian Granit was called upon by Skriath to assist in halting the spread of quicksand in the Weatherworn Dunes. Anasta was due to come too, to protect the Earth Guardian.
    
    Brutus was visibly moved by the truth, as the suspicions in his heart were at long last confirmed: This noble warrior in front of him had never truly betrayed her people. Brutus took a long, shuddering breath, while Anasta gazed upon her favored student before speaking slowly: "Sacrifices must be made, for Mauler unity... And when the tribe is in crisis, it falls to the Blood Claw to lead the way."
    Presently, Anasta looked to Skriath and inquired why he had come to the Weatherworn Dunes. He explained the purpose of his trip: the elemental imbalance was growing, and terrible creatures called Corruptors were rampaging, foreshadowing imminent catastrophe. Only Elemental Guardians could prevent such catastrophe but Granit was busy dealing with the quicksand and was unable to leave the desert. Crucially, some individuals were able to inherit the power of the Earth Emblem, and Skriath believed that Anasta was a prime candidate.
    And now Granit's voice rumbled from nearby: "There is a heavy price for accepting the Earth Emblem. The Emblem brings with it not just power, but unknown adversity. It represents a mortal attraction to all Corruptors, as the two are natural enemies and ceaselessly stalk each other. You will never know another second's true safety."
    Anasta did not hesitate, having long ago decided to give everything for her tribe. Just as she was about to accept her new role, Brutus strode forward. Standing in front of Granit he demanded, "Let me do this."
    Brutus knew that his mentor had already shouldered too much. He felt that now was the time to step up and take on her task and responsibility, no matter the price. He gazed resolutely at his mentor: "When the tribe is in crisis, it falls to the Blood Claw to lead the way."
    The Earth Emblem soared from Granit's body, and attached itself above Brutus' sword hilt. He is about to set foot on a new path but, before he begins, he still has one more thing to do.
    
    Brutus slowly emerges from the temple, whence he had just recovered the cloak and crown sealed within. Where once he had rejected these sacred items of the Blood Claw, now he will proudly complete his mission as the true Mauler Blood Claw.
    Outside the temple, a dense crowd of Corruptors had gathered, drawn by the Elemental Emblem. Faced with such a writhing mass of foes, Brutus grasps his weapon firmly and strides resolutely forward. He has eyes only for his enemy, while the sage words of his mentor echo in his heart:
    
    "Maulers, born from defiance.
    We possess an indomitable will that courses through our veins, and the Blood Claw is the absolute manifestation of this will.
    One day in the future, you shall inherit this will of ours, and become the Blood Claw.
    The road is fated to be difficult, surrounded by powerful enemies, outnumbered and alone.
    When the Tribe needs you, you must rise to the occasion.
    Your body a blade, carve your way forward!"
    
    Brutus' pace quickens as he rushes into the mass of Corruptors, his sharp blade felling them on all sides.
