1.Title: Impending Doom
1.Story:
Esperia is facing an unprecedented crisis: the chaotic elements are wreaking havoc in the realm. The Dark Forest, which has only ever known peace, is not spared from the imminent threat. The Corruptors are advancing in full force, the living beings in the forest are acting strangely, and wildfires and tsunamis may strike any time…
    To restore the peace of the Dark Forest, the Wilder girl emerged from the depths of the woods and joined the squad led by the divine bird, to search for the key to balance the Elements.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Story: A faction's sigil is much more than just a trinket. It is a symbol imbued with great meaning, a physical representation of the faction's honor, its accomplishments, its integrity. Though a sigil is always heavily guarded, the chaos of conflict can scatter even the most precious treasures to the wind. In order to restore the honor of their factions, heroes from across the realm will set out to gather the lost sigils, facing impossible odds and hundreds of pitfalls along the way.

1.Title: Woodland Torrent
1.Story:
An introverted girl who lives deep in the forest, she hears the voices of the plants. 
Spending her whole life in the forest, she never once thought about setting foot outside. 
But as the elemental chaos spread, she could not escape the cries of the forest. 
Shrinking back no more, the young woman was determined to protect the voices in her ears. 
And so took the first courageous step into the unknown.

1.Title: Celestial Celebrations
1.Story: Few traces of treasured items left by the deities many ages ago remain, but that does not hamper the joy that ordinary Esperians feel when they embark upon their search for these coveted items. The mortals' creativity has unlimited possibilities. The treasured boxes created by the gods have been gradually dismantled and imitated by mortal craftsmen over many years, giving rise to an annual celebration, an event that many folk look forward to. When autumn arrives in Esperia, it can only mean one thing: the celebration is about to begin. Many folk create their own exquisite treasured boxes and await those who are smart enough to unlock the delights hidden within them. Some folk rejoice in their new findings, others are left empty-handed, sighing with disappointment. But it is precisely this type of anticipation which makes this celebration so special.

1.Title: Plentiful Delights
1.Story: "Esperians place treasures in their treasure boxes, which they open on the day of celebration. Only the wise and the fortuitous can reveal the treasures." -Gretel Hawke, Esperian Delights.

1.Title: Chapter 3 Dark Undercurrents
1.Story:
When the unbalanced elements envelop the forest
A shy girl meets a boy

The very trees cry out at the elemental chaos  
Together the two travel to the secret at the forest's heart  

Where the Elemental Emblem lies hidden in the Yuexi Spring
The treacherous boy attempts to seize it for himself

But before the Emblem is found, monsters attack
The boy repents with his life, so the girl can escape

But she cannot bear to abandon her former companion
Her loyalty elicits a response from a water element

Monsters retreat where the water flows
Her newfound powers will protect the forest's tranquility

1.Title: Glorified Guilds
1.Story:
Esperia is never short of heroes throughout its long history. Once rallied together, they prevail in battles, saving the world from its turmoils. Here are held the records of outstanding teams who have fought for Esperia's peace and tranquility. They are the pioneers admired by many, and the role models for others to follow.
    When crisis befalls Esperia yet again, the departed comrades will gather under the flag, ready to sound the horn of victory once more.

1.Title: Beast Clash
1.Story:
In Esperia, there exists a group of beasts with special abilities. Previously imprisoned by the God of the Hunt in the Hunting Fields, they began roaming in the wild after the grounds were destroyed, eventually becoming acquainted with the warriors of Esperia. Known as "beasts", these special creatures have been seen fighting alongside heroes in many famous battles.
The beasts do not stop fighting even during peaceful times. The empire's armies hold a Beast Tournament, where the skills of beasts and their bonds with their owners are tested. Whether on a battlefield or tournament ground, the beasts work with their owners as they unleash their true strength and wild nature in combats of tooth and claw, to win the honor of the strongest beast.

1.Title: Bravery Rewards
1.Story: Weapons must be sharpened at all times, even when wars and conflicts may seem impossible. The same is true for warriors and beasts. In this tournament, beasts will hone their teeth and claws on the arena from one battle to the next, as they compete for the ultimate title. A claw-emblazoned medallion will be awarded to the greatest beast warrior, as a badge of honor and a testament to its glory.

1.Title: Unrest of the Undead
1.Story:
After death, the order of the world has fallen apart. The erratic flow of elements has once again sent Bantus, the forsaken kingdom, spiralling into chaos. As the antithesis to the living, the Graveborn are wary about this turmoil, while some are completely indifferent. There are also those who see it as an opportunity to achieve their agenda...
    Far away in the distant seas, the peace the Island of the Banished has always known is about to be broken…

1.Title: Noctis Animarum Festival
1.Story:
Still upset about missing the Summer Event, Princess Peggy grabbed Pippa and Raku, hoping to find some fresh adventures at the Noctis Animarum Festival.
This year, the group welcomed a new friend—Mira. To liven things up, Pippa gleefully cast a spell to bring the pumpkins "to life" and join the festivities! Mira wanted to help too, and poured her own power into "reviving" the pumpkins...
But when their arcane power collided with the pumpkins, something went terribly wrong. Many of them rose in fury, shouting that they'd had enough of being carved up and treated as playthings. They stormed off in a rage, scattering in every direction. To make matters worse, the leftover magic radiating from their bodies swept through the crowd, dragging many festival-goers into the chaos.
With no other choice, Princess Peggy and her friends joined forces to confront the "pumpkin siege", determined to restore order to a Noctis Animarum gone out of control.

1.Title: Death Reborn
1.Story:
The future hope of the Lightbearer Empire died in battle saving his best friend.
However, peace does not always follow death.
Teased by fate, the warrior wandered as an undead,
until he encountered the Tainted on the Island of the Banished.
When the unbalanced elements wrought havoc on the isle,
the warrior rose to its rescue despite his long-rotten body.
When one has something dear to protect,
they can hold their weapons tight even with decayed hands.

1.Title: Swamp Corruptor
1.Story:
The Corruptors are unnatural elemental monsters. They are born on realms plagued by elemental imbalance, so their appearance is closely related to the topography of their birthplace. The Corruptors from the dunes are covered in gravel and stones, while those in the dense forest on the Island of the Banished are characterized by rotten wood, dried bones, and swampy features.
    The Swamp Corruptor is a unique entity among the Corruptors. Its body is formed of decayed wood and dried bones, where erratic elemental force grows rampant. Anything he sees turns into filthy mud of swamps.

1.Title: Chapter 4: Blight
1.Story:
On that forsaken Graveborn isle,
the scourge of elemental imbalance has descended.

The Elemental Guardian is held captive,
the wandering knight comes to rescue unattended.

They traveled through dark woods,
and encounter a monster with sharp claws.

With its unrelenting attacks,
the two could not escape without cause.

A flashing blade emerges out of nowhere.
The swordsman has arrived almost out of thin air.

Old friends reunite and fight back-to-back.
The knight and the swordsman join together and attack.

The power of the wood element flows into the knight.
The tide has turned, and the heroes deal a divine smite.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Story:
Ladies and gentlemen! With the sun shining brightly, what a great time for the Megamouth Shark Troupe to once again go on tour!
    Get ready to bear witness to Oakenfell's most extraordinary performers and magicians! There's no other people or place which can wow you.
    During our tour, we'll also be holding a competition! Defeat the performers and receive a special, bespoke Megamouth Shark Troupe reward for your efforts, as long as you collect it in person.
    Don't miss this amazing opportunity, you might just regret it!

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Story: Periodically, the Megamouth Shark Troupe will tour the Royal capital Savannah for half a month. These packed tours attract people from all over sending ticket prices skyrocketing. Performances include knife juggling, fire-breathing, trapeze artists and the ever-thrilling Magic Hat trick.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Story:
The Megamouth Shark Troupe is Oakenfell's resident Circus Troupe. They hold big performances three times a month and every one is a sell-out show.
    As well as performing in Oakenfell, the Troupe also travels the world putting on shows. The Megamouth Shark Troupe has brought laughter to every corner of Esperia, and the Troupe's Mr Wake has collected innumerable goodies from all over the world.
    Only the Megamouth Shark Troupe's most loyal audience members can redeem the commemorative medal for Mr Wake's exclusive treasure.

1.Title: Haze of Terror
1.Story:
The Cursed Realm conjured by Ezizh is always filled with thick, disorienting haze. Many who were trapped in there lost their minds after touching the haze. Those who survived said the realm reveals everyone's weakness and worst nightmares.
    But you can take full control of this nightmare, as long as you face your deepest fears and dispel the haze of terror within you.
    It is a test. Each round of damage dealt to the Haze of Terror will increase the strength in you, and transform into greater control by you over the realm.
    After the trial is over and the haze is conquered, everything in the Cursed Realm will be as you wish, whether you leave or stay.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Story: A faction's sigil is much more than just a trinket. It is a symbol imbued with great meaning, a physical representation of the faction's honor, its accomplishments, its integrity. Though a sigil is always heavily guarded, the chaos of conflict can scatter even the most precious treasures to the wind. In order to restore the honor of their factions, heroes from across the realm will set out to gather the lost sigils, facing impossible odds and hundreds of pitfalls along the way.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Story: The Tulip Poetry Circle is a social group of bards, musicians and other artists located within Oakenfell. The artists in the poetry society would take to the streets from time to time, reciting heroic epics and rural legends, also finding new material and inspirations to compose new poems from those they met on the streets of Oakenfell. Most of the art that the Tulip Poetry Circle create can be traced back to historical deeds that took truly took place.

1.Title: Wreathz
1.Story: It is said that the beasts' favorite treasures are contained in Wreathz's rucksack. It's time to teach this scoundrel a lesson!

1.Title: Beast Squad
1.Story: The first day of heavy snowfall marks the celebration of the Midwinter Festival. People prepare well in advance for the festivities. However, this year the snow came sooner than earlier years, catching people unawares. The Empire have urgently issued a draft and the big guilds are springing into action to save the Midwinter Festival. People are working every spare moment but it is still not enough. There are so many incomplete tasks: gathering firewood, creating ice sculptures, delivering letters, collecting fruits, hunting... Lucky for them the beasts have stepped up and these reliable creatures are organizing into special teams and ready to work their hardest! All they ask for in return is a small reward from the guilds. They may prove to be the best help in times of need.

1.Title: Sparks of Dawn
1.Story: Thane and his team have delivered a message, that they have figured out the cause of the elemental imbalance and why it has led to so many calamities. To end all this, the forces of all the Elemental Guardians must be present. The Lightbearer Empire and its people have been ravaged by the scourge for months and are nearing their breaking point. Oh my heroes who trust in the Divine Light: The final test is upon us. Make your choice now.

1.Title: The Frosty Isles
1.Story:
"Frigid air blows down over the lofty mountaintops and crash on the shivering lowlands like an avalanche. The winds howl the song of the Frozen Mother. Winter has arrived."
    -excerpt from a dwarven hunting journal, recorded by Gretel Hawke

    Atop snow-capped peaks, far from the reach of even the most adventurous mortals, lies the home of the gods. When winter arrives, Esperians will sing songs and prepare for festivals to honor the goddess of winter. Though she is known by many names: The Frozen Mother, Frostbearer, Snowsong, and many others, all refer to the same goddess. Alna, The First Winter.

    Most portrayals of Alna show a stoic, strong woman hefting a sword of ice. These are accurate, and her personality is every bit as cold as her outward appearance. She is a solitary being by nature, and even on the rare occasion that one of the gods will seek her out for one purpose or another, she offers few words and little hospitality. She is the embodiment of the season that drives people indoors to huddle around their hearths, the season that freezes cattle and sheep in the fields and denies living things the bounties of the land. She is cold and unforgiving, and an inevitable part of life. This wasn't, however, always the case.

    Millenia ago she was a much less powerful deity with a far shorter reach. Simply a guardian of the mountains. A protector of the high places. In those days, winter didn't exist. Years passed without change in a state of constant bloom and snow was something of which no mortal had ever dreamt. It wasn't until the first demonic invasion that the full extent of her hidden power was realized. The invaders were spreading everywhere, and eventually they entered Alna's realm. She fought them off, but they seemed to be without number. No matter how many she slayed on the slopes and clifftops, there were more. In her anger, she let loose a shriek that echoed through the valleys. With it came blasts of freezing wind and, for the first time, snow. The invaders were buried in drifts and frozen where they stood, their bodies locked forever into huddled positions. The cold didn't simply cover the mountains, however. It swept down through the land, and thus the first winter was born.

    Every following year Alna has shrieked from the mountaintops, ushering in another winter. Though many mortals bemoan the difficulty and discomfort of the season, it brings with it some benefits. The spread of disease is slowed or halted and rot is staved off. Great beasts go into hibernation and the hardworking folk of the fields get time to rest indoors. Winter is a time of bitterness and an element of danger, but also a time of cheer and togetherness. It is with her season that Alna reminds the mortals of Esperia that sacrifices must be made in order to reap rewards.

1.Title: Frosty Festivities
1.Story: "Frigid air blows down over the lofty mountaintops and crashes on the shivering lowlands like an avalanche." -Gretel Hawke, A Dwarven Hunting Journal

1.Title: Bringer of Blessings
1.Story:
The residents of Harmony City light firecrackers during festivities, which are said to ward off evil and bring blessings. One of their customs is the Firecracker Arena, a contest where participants must compete to light the most firecrackers and produce the loudest blast. However, there is more to the tournament than lighting firecrackers. Players also have to fend off magical stone lions and overcome multiple hurdles. Spectators give the loudest cheer to winner who manages to light the firecrackers on the arena!
    Harmony City welcomes all guests from near and far to receive blessings together!

1.Title: Sacred Dawn
1.Story:
Belinda, a priestess of the Temple of Light, is devoted to the Divine Light.
In this devastating disaster, the Divine Light is unable to relieve the suffering of its followers.
When seeking solutions from the elements,
Belinda was overwhelmed by confusion, speculation, and blame.
"What is her deepest faith?" she questioned herself.
The answer she found,
through trials of burning flames.

1.Title: Chapter 5: Dawn of Hope
1.Story:
The young priestess prays reverently in the temple,
For the darkness to remain far from the Lightbearer Empire.

The dead lie still,
The Light finding no purchase.

The girl grasps for some other means to avert disaster,
Finding faint hope in tales of Elemental power.

Her mentor, devout in his belief in the Light, denies her entreaty.
Thus she travels. Alone, far from home, looking for traces of the Elements.

A long and arduous journey it is, over many days and nights,
Until at last the Elemental Emblem appears, deep within a volcano.

Blazing fire answers the maiden's call,
And the radiance of sacred flames envelops the earth.

1.Title: Wish Finder
1.Story:
It is the most extreme period of winter when frigid winds blow over Esperia. On the coldest day, the people of Esperia light up flames in various ways to illuminate the realm and protect everyone from Hypogeans, conveying hope, peace and warmth. This is the origin of the Spring Spree.
 
It is believed that on this day, the Obsidian Finches, creatures linking the Divine and Earthly flames, will appear, lighting up the whole of Esperia by igniting the ground with fire. Then each day will grow warmer, until winter gives way to spring.
 
After the last Obsidian Finch was reborn from fire, a Phoenix Flower tree bloomed in the Dark Forest. Since then, the people of Esperia have been writing their wishes on a wooden card attached with the feather of an Obsidian Finch, and hanging them on the tree. They believe by doing that, their wishes will reach the God of Flame.

1.Title: Inseparable Friends
1.Story:
The Blooming Branch is the most common sweetener native to Hathor. Among many other competing flavoring ingredients, it is the unassuming Blooming Branch that became an essential seasoning in many cuisines.
In line with the simple people who lives in rustic villages, even a return gift has to be practical.
As a return gift for someone brave enough to express their feelings to you, this Blooming Branch expresses not only the message: "Thank you for sweetening my life", it also carries the meaning: "I hope that our future days together will remain sweet evermore."

1.Title: Shepherd's Serenade
1.Story:
Once upon a time, a couple who got lost in a forest was guided out by a mythical deer. From then on, the couple enjoyed a life blessed by the gods, and lived happily ever after. Every since then, this legend gradually evolved into a beautiful holiday: Lovepetal Day.
It is said that if you confess your feelings to your loved one on Lovepetal Day, your passion will receive the blessing of the gods.
Even rustic villages celebrate Lovepetal Day. People who are used to a simple life often do not know how to express their love, and thus they take advantage of the chance this festival presents to confess their unspoken feelings. Even those unskilled with words are able to convey their feelings through the use flower bouquets, and express their feelings using the love language of the flowers. Indeed, it is this very act that forms the basis of Lovepetal Day.
Life requires more than bread to fill the stomach, it also requires flowers to express emotions. But as Gretel Hawke once said - the most important thing is for a couple to join hands and overcome their fear of the unknown future together with hope and optimism.

1.Title: Belinda - Spark of Hope: Sacred Dawn
1.Story:
"Have you made your mind up, Belinda?"
    In a lava-filled cave deep within the volcanic wasteland of the western Lightbearer Empire, the Fire Elemental Guardian asks the young woman for her final answer.
    Belinda raises her head, exhaustion written on her fair face. Her features are blackened with ash, while her pure white dress is singed and charred by the oppressive heat. Her journey in search of the Fire Guardian had been long and torturous, but her arrival here does not signify an end to her ordeal. The choice she now faced could very well make things even harder, but her steady eyes shone bright with determination:
    "You are not the first to ask me this. Moreover, I've known the answer for a very long time already."
 
 
    A dozen days previously, Belinda had walked hesitantly around the cloisters of the temple, Bishop Palmer's questions still ringing in her ears.
    "Have you made your mind up, Belinda?"
    The peace of the Lightbearer Empire had recently been shattered, when monsters known as Corruptors suddenly appeared in every corner of the land. Even General Rayne had been injured, slipping into a coma from which she could not be awakened. Belinda had tried nonetheless, only to find that the healing power of the Light had no effect on Estrilda or other comatose patients. To make matters worse, the frequency of Corruptor incursions was increasing, with ever more civilians falling before their foul talons. The Temple of Light, always before a place of healing, was now powerless in the face of the comas wrought by Corruptors.
    A spark of hope soon flared, however. The next time Belinda visited Rayne Manor to see how Estrilda fared, a letter from the housekeeper Thane explained the cause behind the current disaster: a catastrophic elemental imbalance, which could only be rectified by finding the five Elemental Guardians.
    She raced back to the Temple and told all this to her mentor, Bishop Palmer. She hoped they might dispatch someone to help scour the volcanic west of the Empire for the Fire Guardian. But Palmer did not immediately grant her request, instead asking if she was sure about her plan, and encouraging her to look deep within herself.
    Belinda understood the Temple's misgivings. To seek salvation anywhere other than the Light would, in the eyes of the laity, be tantamount to admitting the Light's impotence. Insisting on seeking out the Elemental Guardian would also be seen as heresy, and she would be branded an apostate. Distraught, she wondered what else she could do if the Temple refused to help. Suddenly, without even realizing it, she found herself before the door to the Temple, where a commotion brought her back to the present.
    There was a crowd of those afflicted by the disaster, their clothes torn and shabby. Some still clutched small children in their arms as the sisters and brothers of the clergy went among them, handing out bread. When Belinda approached, they noticed her clerical apparel and surged towards her, fervent hope filling their tired eyes.
    A young mother held her child up in front of Belinda, another young victim of the Corruptors. Sadly, this was all too common these days. Belinda knew that the Light had no effect on the afflictions caused by the Corruptors, but also knew that she could not sit idly by as mothers like this looked at her as if she was their final hope.
    Belinda stretched out her hands, letting the Light envelop the child's body. But nothing happened, just like the many other times she had tried and failed.
    The mother fell to her knees, sobbing, as the hope faded from her eyes. Her tears carved two shining paths as they cut through the grime that coated her face: "Is it... Is it because we are not devout enough? I'll dedicate the rest of my life to the Light just please, I beg you... Save my child..." Behind her were countless others, whose gaze swept by the kneeling woman to fall on Belinda.
    She couldn't bear the hope and helplessness in the eyes of the supplicants and made up her mind there and then. There could be no more delay. The Elemental Guardian must be found, and the root cause of this crisis put right.
    "The Light shall protect you."
    Belinda bowed slightly to the despairing crowd, then turned and walked back to the Temple.
 
 
    She burst into his study to find Bishop Palmer sitting with his head in one hand, the other on the desk. He appeared to be examining some important documents.
    "I ask you to let me go to the volcano and find the Elemental Guardian." Belinda broke the silence first. "The elemental imbalance is destroying Esperia's peace. As the priestess of the Temple, I am responsible for thousands of the Empire's citizens."
    Palmer didn't raise his head, but continued staring at the documents before him: "The Light will protect this land, as always."
    "The Light... is not omnipotent."
    Palmer finally looked up, his tone grave as he spoke: "You're treading on dangerous ground, priestess."
    Belinda took a deep breath, aware that she had never before known so clearly what she was going to do. Determined, she speaks resolutely to Palmer: "The elemental chaos must be traced back to its source, and I'm sure the Light will tolerate our pressing need to save people. Please, Bishop, allow me to go at once."
    "The Temple has its own ways to save people. Remember your vows to the Light, priestess."
    "I'm living up to those vows right now." Belinda took a step forward and stood right in front of the desk, looking the Bishop square in the eye, "By the Light above, I will return with hope!"
    Palmer was silent. Ignoring Belinda, he got up without a word and left the study, leaving on his desk what appeared to be an old map. A route was traced on the map, a route which led to the legendary volcano.
    "The Light has always shown me the way," Belinda murmured to herself as she looked towards where Palmer had left. Then, grasping the map tightly, she set out on her journey to the volcano.
 
 
    In the searing heat of the volcano, the Fire Guardian watches the young woman carefully. He saw her perseverance and her faith, but inheriting the Elemental Emblem meant responsibility, and a high price for it: to become the target of the Corruptors, chased endlessly. It was not a decision to be taken lightly.
    "The Light has already written the answer in my heart." Facing the figure in the flames, Belinda seemed to be answering her mentor. "The instant I was ordained, I swore to the Light that I would devote my whole being to my calling, and never abandon anyone who could be saved!"
    The Fire Guardian nodded. "Then it shall be as you wish."
    A mystical rune landed in Belinda's palm, which suddenly burst into violent, surging flames and merged with the pure light that emanated from her. The sacred, golden flames enveloped her, making her seem like a blazing torch that dispelled the darkness and illuminated the dawn. Her hand emerged from the fire, grasping a newly transformed staff.
    The power to save souls was now hers, and she would return bearing renewed hope.

1.Title: Nightmare Corridor
1.Story:
On the border where dreams and reality converge, countless nightmares lurk. As Ezizh's power expands, the boundaries become ever more blurred. He is all set to infiltrate the waking world with his nightmares.
    Heeding Tasi's call, the Dream Divers have arrived to stop Ezizh, but the cunning Hypogean is well-prepared. He turns nightmares into shadows and traps the Dream Divers in multiple dream realms full of these evil shadows. If they fail to extricate themselves, they will fall into an endless abyss.
    Reality must never be invaded by nightmares. The Dream Divers can only stop this impending disaster by exterminating the evil shadows and fleeing the Nightmare Corridor.

1.Title: Clawlossus
1.Story:
A vast open sea that is the domain of sunken ships and the dead, where hull remains float on the waters and abound on shores. The grudge of countless casualties converges at the center of the ocean, as the Sunken Cemetery, the lair of Clawlossus, becomes a cage that imprisons these lost souls.
    Originally a hermit crab, Clawlossus once roamed freely in the endless ocean. But as more and more lives were lost to the sea, the grudge of these souls began to converge on his tiny body and shell. Now, he can no longer escape the dark depths of the ocean, and the remains of shipwrecks form the armor over his broken body.
    Plagued by the grudge and the pain of "immortality", he thought of escaping, but once he discovered how delicious a soul tastes, the idea of an "eternal life" seemed bearable after all. Any vessel passing through the sea will sink, as he feeds on the hapless souls it carries.
    Clawlossus relishes in imprisoning and feeding on souls. He subjects innocent souls to eternal torture and lets them witness his endless plunder, as they eventually rot together in this purgatory.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Story:
Ladies and gentlemen! With the sun shining brightly, what a great time for the Megamouth Shark Troupe to once again go on tour!
    Get ready to bear witness to Oakenfell's most extraordinary performers and magicians! There's no other people or place which can wow you.
    During our tour, we'll also be holding a competition! Defeat the performers and receive a special, bespoke Megamouth Shark Troupe reward for your efforts, as long as you collect it in person.
    Don't miss this amazing opportunity, you might just regret it!

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Story: Periodically, the Megamouth Shark Troupe will tour the Royal capital Savannah for half a month. These packed tours attract people from all over sending ticket prices skyrocketing. Performances include knife juggling, fire-breathing, trapeze artists and the ever-thrilling Magic Hat trick.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Story:
The Megamouth Shark Troupe is Oakenfell's resident Circus Troupe. They hold big performances three times a month and every one is a sell-out show.
    As well as performing in Oakenfell, the Troupe also travels the world putting on shows. The Megamouth Shark Troupe has brought laughter to every corner of Esperia, and the Troupe's Mr Wake has collected innumerable goodies from all over the world.
    Only the Megamouth Shark Troupe's most loyal audience members can redeem the commemorative medal for Mr Wake's exclusive treasure.

1.Title: The Bastion Beckons
1.Story: The catastrophe caused by the elemental chaos has been ravaging for months, and the whole of Esperia has fallen into turmoil. The source of the disaster is now clear, and the successors to the five Elemental Emblems have gathered, heading to the Elemental Temples deep in the forest. The Elemental Altar is about to be opened, and the realm is about to be fixed... However, there may be deeper secrets at play behind the heroes' journeys.

1.Title: From Flames to Ashes
1.Story:
The former ruler of the Obsidian Finches discovered that the divine avians' duty to save the world had been cloaked in lies:
She watched as her subjects were consumed and sacrificed to mend the flaws in the world's creation.
Her grief and rage transformed her into a Hypogean. For thousands of years she bided her time, seeking out ways to bring her people back.
It was not until the Elemental Strife that an opportunity to resurrect her people finally presented itself.
The fallen Celestial unfolded her flaming wings:
"The mortals call me a Hypogean, but I shall never bow to Gods that have done naught for my people!"

1.Title: Nightmare Dashboard
1.Story: To prevent Ezizh from encroaching the waking realm, the Dream Divers compile the evil shadows they have encountered in the Nightmare Corridor into a book, to find the real nightmare hidden behind every shadow.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Story: The Tulip Poetry Circle is a social group of bards, musicians and other artists located within Oakenfell. The artists in the poetry society would take to the streets from time to time, reciting heroic epics and rural legends, also finding new material and inspirations to compose new poems from those they met on the streets of Oakenfell. Most of the art that the Tulip Poetry Circle create can be traced back to historical deeds that took truly took place.

1.Title: Final Chapter: The Solaran Reckoning
1.Story:
The elements ran rampant across Esperia,
Plunging the world into chaos.

As the inheritors of the Emblems gathered in the Bastion of the Elements,
A sinister, long-simmering plot came to light.

Dark chains bound the divine avian in the heart of the volcano.
Casting off her disguise,
The scholar revealed her true, Hypogean colors.

Breaking free of her chains, the divine avian charged towards her captor.
Savage flames lit the cavern, both holy and demonic.

Black feathers floated down like cinders...
The Hypogean's evil had been purified by the flames of the divine.

Thus did celestial radiance reach every corner of the land,
Dispelling the darkness and bringing an end to the Elemental Strife.

1.Title: Maetria - Duskfeather
1.Story:
"When darkness covers the world, the divine avians shall become the fiery salvation of all living things." Such are the great legends regarding the mythical "Obsidian Finches," a species only recorded in the most ancient of histories but which nonetheless once soared high above the skies of Esperia.
 
    It was in that ancient era that Maetria was born. From the time she first opened her eyes in her mother's nest, she had always held fast to the sacred mission told to her again and again by the eldest of the Obsidian Finches. Their sacred duty—the reason for their whole existence—was to protect Esperia.
 
    By the time of the great Elemental Strife that engulfed Esperia, Maetria's dedication to the mission of her race saw her rise to the position of chief over her people. She remembered keenly the words of her ancestors, and leapt into action to save the mortals scurrying fearfully about under their watchful eye. It was her burden, her duty, her honor, to play the role of savior.
 
    The Elemental Strife brought total calamity upon the helpless citizens of a frightened world. But it was nothing unexpected to Maetria and her folk. It was time for their mission to be fulfilled.
 
    Maetria honored all the old precepts taught to her and traveled deep into the Solaran Furnace. There, without reservation, she released the Solaris Flare that dwelled inside her. The ritual had begun. The burning Solaris Flare pierced the ground and lit up the sky in a magnificent display of celestial power, spreading across Esperia and cleansing it of all elemental disorder. Though Maetria felt the power being stripped from her body, she did not then lament the loss of her life, her mind filled only with joy at the glorious fulfilment of her mission. But this pride did not last long. She began to notice a new phenomenon; first with terror, then horror, and finally anger.
 
    She saw all her kinsfolk, all of the other Obsidian Finches, some of whom she had grown up with in the same nest, fall from the sky as the divine Solaris Flare within their bodies was ripped away. She watched them groan on the earth, dying, their feathers fading from brilliant red to gray and then finally ash as the life drained from their bodies. One hatchling Maetria knew well tried desperately to fly over for help. She was already a heap of ash by the time she landed at Maetria's feet.
 
    Maetria had been proud to do her part to save the world—the mission entrusted to her since birth. Yet no one had ever told her that saving the world would also come at the cost of her entire race.
 
    Maetria drew upon all the divine energy within her to try to halt the ritual, but there was nothing she could do. Virtually every member of her race was already dead or dying. Most cried out in pain as they faded to ash in front of her eyes. Maetria also sensed her own life force fading. It was then she came to the cruel realization that, in the end, all of the fanciful-sounding phrases about doing "what is best for Esperia" were nothing more than hollow lies to enable her species' exploitation. No! She resolved to herself. She would not give herself up in sacrifice, she would not die here! She vowed revenge on the world that had cruelly taken her kinsfolk away.
 
    Maetria's anger and desperate desire to save her species called out through the void to sinister forces like a beacon. Fell Hypogeans proffered a deal that Maetria quickly accepted: become their infernal vessel in exchange for unimaginable power. With the power to cheat death, she would live, and as long as she lived there was a hope of restoring her race, of reawakening them from the ash. She would stop at nothing to do so. Soon she emerged from the ash of her dying existence covered in dark flames— Hypogean flames.
 
    Maetria lay in wait for centuries, seeking some means by which the Obsidian Finches could be restored to life. And so passed a thousand years of futile searching, until finally she found the truth about her species' creation, as well as a way forward.
 
    Honas, the God of Creation, crafted the Furnace in the void when he made the world. From the sun he plucked a spark—called the "Solaris Flare"—and mixed it with the elemental forces to create Esperia. Yet a dark force of cosmic chaos had interfered with his great work. Hence, Esperia from its very inception possessed a slight imbalance between the elements, which would eventually culminate in disaster. It was a great defect in Honas' work, but he had a solution. He embedded his Furnace within the planet, in a place virtually undiscoverable. This became the "Solaran Furnace."
 
    Within the Furnace, Honas hid a special stone. Over the centuries, the stone would absorb the Solaran power and give birth to a race of divine avians—the Obsidian Finches.
 
    Eventually the disorder in Esperia's elemental forces culminated in the cataclysm once foretold. It was the Obsidian Finches, the carriers of the Solaris Flare, who were tasked with recreating the world without the imperfections in Honas' original work. Within the Furnace, the Obsidian Finches would have to release the Solaris Flare within themselves, allowing its divine power to spread across the land, seas, and skies. As the essence of their being, removing the Flare from the divine avians would result in their deaths. To protect Esperia with the Solaris Flare would be the glorious burden they would have to bear; yet to Maetria it seemed more a criminal's sentence. The Obsidian Finches were, in the end, no more than tools for correcting the Creator's mistakes, victims of his deceit. They were kindling to be burned.
 
    In this terrible truth, however, Maetria also uncovered a possible means to revive her kinfolk. There was still one Obsidian Finch left, and were the Elemental Strife to strike once more, she would only have to lead this last Finch to the Solaran Furnace. Using the remnants of the Solaris Flare within the last Finch, she could reignite the dormant Furnace and give her people a chance at rebirth.
 
    Maetria waited until a new Strife afflicted Esperia. Talene, the last Obsidian Finch, had made herself known, and within her dwelled the last vestiges of the Solaris Flare. By now, Maetria had waited for millennia, but the time had come for her plans to finally bear fruit. Taking on the guise of a Wilder scholar, she appeared before Talene when the time was right.
 
    "Honored Obsidian Finch, let me tell you a story of the divine avians of old..."

1.Title: The Fire Daemon
1.Story:
Even among the Hypogeans, the Fire Daemons are their worst nightmare. Legend has it that they were once gods, but no-one knows why they had fallen into the realm of the Hypogeans.
    Their gargantuan size is enough to strike mortal fear in the creatures of Esperia. It may also mislead ignorant folks into underestimating their intelligence, in which case the cruel monsters will make these fools pay the heftiest price for their stupidity.
    As incarnations of slaughter and destruction, the Fire Daemons have no mercy with their world-ending powers. Their insatiable desire for destruction drives them to kill in the simplest and crudest ways. Laying waste wherever they go, they derive ultimate pleasure from acts of wanton destruction.

1.Title: The Celestial Isles
1.Story: The strange cubes found upon the celestial isles were created by Ansiel, the Heavenly Crafter. They were used to keep the celestial artifacts from the hands of those with evil intent. Meticulously crafted from ethereal energies made tangible, they are as intricate as they are secure. Each cube consists of multiple parts that twist and rearrange into protective patterns that give way only to a celestial key. Acquiring something so valuable as a celestial key, however, is far from an easy task.

1.Title: Celestial Offerings
1.Story: "If both eyes are veiled by the mist, heed your heart. Allow the will of the gods to guide you to the gifts hidden amongst the stones." —Gretel Hawke, Esperian Records of the Bizarre.

1.Title: Cosmic Impact
1.Story: The people of Esperia have finally had a period of peace. However, beyond the mortal eye, the paths of the stars have quietly changed in the distant sky. A rare and spectacular meteor shower travels across the night sky, and is met with excited cheers and applause from the people. However, little do they know that disaster and turbulence are upon them...

1.Title: Diver's Quest
1.Story:
In the abyss that has been unreachable by humans for thousands of years, surging souls are causing the sunken city to resurface. No-one knows how these legendary civilizations vanished, and many versions of the truth have been circulated over the generations.
    Some speculate that the city declined and disappeared due to the destructive havoc wrought by strange and frequent calamities. Others suspect that the people of the civilization had incurred the wrath of the gods, and so it was divine punishment that had led to their eternal doom. It has also been said that the city's residents had discovered the truth of the world, and that forced them to exile themselves in order to protect the forbidden force. As a result, they abandoned their civilization and let it fall into decline. Their disappearance may have only occurred in the blink of an eye, but the lost city continues to draw thousands of treasure hunters, with the mysterious appeal of its shadowy legends and ancient ruins.
    The bottomless and enigmatic ocean cannot stop the quests of the treasure seekers. Whether they will be met with treasures or deadly traps, has long been decided by the dark currents and turbulent waves. Fearless treasurers are plunging deep into the abyss, in search of the extinct civilization... or treasures!

1.Title: Forsaken Treasure
1.Story:
All the restless activity has been triggered by the smashing of the soul shackles in these deadly waters, which is bringing the ruins to the surface of the sea once again.
    No-one knows what mysteries are hidden in the sunken city. Few clues can be found in the writings of adventurers or by following the trails of every treasure seeker before. Indeed, to a treasure hunter, nothing can be more fascinating than a sunken civilization and its lost treasures. While the deep bottomless ocean can be terrifying, that is not enough to stop droves of intrepid explorers from flocking there.
    The treasures buried beneath the ocean are like praise to the bravest, a reward to them for bringing the lost civilization back to the world.

1.Title: Chilling Blade
1.Story:
To the world, she is a murderous god that never listens to the prayers of mortals.
After the fall of the goddess, whom she saw as her mother, she traveled the world and slowly understood the goddess' teachings.
The mortals may be weak, but they possess unique, shimmering qualities that cannot be found on the gods.
After witnessing the great suffering and noble character of the mortals, she knew what she must do with the sharp blade in her hands.

1.Title: Duskwailer
1.Story:
This is a tragic tale that echoes in the Boneyard...
    A kingdom ravaged by war. Countless perished soldiers, their bodies sprawled across the wilderness. Some of them were transported back to Bantus, then laid in the Boneyard. Women who have not heard back from their loved ones on the battlefield could only visit this mass grave, wishing and praying they would never see a familiar figure amid the piles of bodies.
    After the empire turned into a Graveborn wasteland, the women could no longer wait patiently as promised. From their resentment rose lonely souls of fear, dressed in tattered wedding gowns and traversing the foggy nights.
    With her blood and soil-stained hands, she keeps solo travelers from leaving and returns with them to the place where she once made a vow with her lover. Even though they are just strangers, she would repeat her question to them, in a voice made hoarse by her incessant wailing: "When are you coming back, my love?"

1.Title: Fidelia
1.Story:
Fidelia symbolizes comrades that always have each other's back and never forsake one another. Behind this meaning is an ancient story:
    Once upon a time, a small militia encountered a teleportation trap while fighting the Hypogeans. So, they were trapped deep in the desert outside of town. The team members who were severely injured decided to hand over their last water and food to the warrior in the best shape, and send him to the town for help.
    When the warrior finally stepped out of the desert, he realized that his footprints and beacons had long been buried in the sand. Just as he was crying in despair on the edge of the desert, blood-red flowers suddenly appeared along his trail, leading deep into the desert and guiding the warrior and townsfolk to his comrades. Thus, it is said that Fidelia is the grace of the gods bestowed after they were moved by the camaraderie of humans.
——Solise's Botanical Notes

1.Title: Blade of Conviction: Chapter 1
1.Story:
In the solemn and sacred temple,
mortals in misery are seeking their final refuge,
while the hunters have broken the peace here.
The trembling folk recognizes her face—
She's Dura's child, but merciless!
She never lets go of anyone to do with the Hypogeans!
Quivering, the people watch as she approaches.
Neither yelling nor crying can stop her surging will to kill.
Under the Divine Light,
her blade slashes through the sacred temple...

1.Title: Mask Curator
1.Story:
"Character is a mask". For the Mask Curator, human nature is simply a mixture of shadows and masks. Be it a noble virtue or despicable trait, it is simply different colors on a mask. His greatest joy lies in the search and extraction of faces with the most vivid expressions.
    The Mask Curator is a breaker of spirits and engulfer of faith, with his cunning manifested by unexpected deception and distraction. He enjoys the process of peeling off a character mask to reveal the ugliness beneath, while the torture of his victims' souls gives him ultimate gratification.
    The self-proclaimed "Mask Curator" takes pleasure in distilling the most distinctive faces from tortured souls, as part of his collection. He keeps his range minimal––only mockery, despair, terror, rage, and cunning are qualified to be his alter egos. These five masks even have their own consciousness: sometimes they stand against common foes as a united front, while at other times they may quarrel with one another.
    The mask collection marks the final struggle of countless souls. After becoming part of the collection through bizarre and twisted means, the souls are held in a formless prison, forever.

1.Title: The Lost Sigils
1.Story: A faction's sigil is much more than just a trinket. It is a symbol imbued with great meaning, a physical representation of the faction's honor, its accomplishments, its integrity. Though a sigil is always heavily guarded, the chaos of conflict can scatter even the most precious treasures to the wind. In order to restore the honor of their factions, heroes from across the realm will set out to gather the lost sigils, facing impossible odds and hundreds of pitfalls along the way.

1.Title: Blade of Conviction: Chapter 2
1.Story:
Having been separated from her mother, a girl sought help from the Goddess of Punishment.
The aloof Goddess did not answer the girl's prayers,
Yet still intervened to save her in the moment of her dire need.
The girl followed the Goddess and reunited with her mother.
As a gift of gratitude, she presented a ragdoll she made herself,
Only to have the Goddess turn away and leave silently…
It is said that the Goddess of Punishment never responds mortals' prayers.
But the truth may not be as clear-cut as that.

1.Title: The Dreamy Garden
1.Story:
Who loves rainbow-colored cotton candy the most?
Which rascal has misplaced their animal mask again?
*Jingle* *Jingle* The cart's supplies make a racket as they're pushed along. 
Spring is leaving and Summer approaches yet again. The annual outing to the Dreamy Garden is underway. It seems to have more than just a few secrets hidden within it. But only the bravest of kids are capable of uncovering the biggest prizes....

1.Title: Blade of Conviction: Chapter 3
1.Story:
The Hypogean emerged from his disguise, and the Blade knew it.
He was a long-time quarry of the Goddess.
A few days prior, the Hypogean attacked a camp,
leaving none but a ragged doll in its ruins…
The Hypogean's ceaseless provocation ignited the Goddess' fury.
Under the Divine Light, the Goddess transformed into a giant sword descending from the heavens!
As divine punishment befell, the Hypogean dissipated in its light.
The Goddess returned the doll and left quietly.
Her faith would no longer waver.
She is the sword of judgment that will punish all evil,
always en-route to the next battlefield.

1.Title: Soul Hound
1.Story:
The Soul Hound was not born an evil monster. It was once a hound of a general of the Empire. Every time its owner whistled, it would respond with a rhythmic bark.
    During war time, it followed its owner to battlefields. With its keen sense of smell and agility, it once saved its owner in a battle, winning a commendation from the Empire. Its absolute obedience to its owner attested to the loyalty of a hound.
    However, its loyalty was not rewarded with kindness. Beguiled by the Hypogeans, its owner sacrificed its soul as a cruel offering in exchange for his own eternal life. Unable to escape the misery, the loyal hound was incarnated into a Hypogean, and all the loyalty it had once shown became but a joke forgotten by its owner.
    Today, the Soul Hound largely retains its previous form, except having split into multiple grotesque heads that constantly taunt its past loyalty. Every time its eyes glow red, innocent souls plunge into purgatory in abject suffering.
    No one knows if any of its squabbling heads still carries the kindness of a loyal hound. But one thing remains the same: each time a whistle is heard, the Soul Hound answers with a deafening howl.

1.Title: Night of Stars
1.Story: The Maulers are never short of conflict or dispute. Their fight for dominance have led to military clashes between their own tribes. However, for some smaller tribes, the only way to secure more advantage and space for survival is by becoming each other's allies. When the Dark Star descended on this land that was rife with greed and desire, the pacts once thought to be iron-clad began to show their cracks under its uncanny light.

1.Title: Game of Desire
1.Story:
The Queen, ousted by the rebels,
has reclaimed her throne with her allies' help.
But when she ruled her clan again,
her former allies became her greatest threat.
Pacts built upon power are fragile.
The balance between Queens trembles.
When an unknown meteor fell to the ground,
the allies began revealing their intentions.
In this game of power and desire,
only one can last till the end.

1.Title: Circus Tour
1.Story:
Ladies and gentlemen! With the sun shining brightly, what a great time for the Megamouth Shark Troupe to once again go on tour!
    Get ready to bear witness to Oakenfell's most extraordinary performers and magicians! There's no other people or place which can wow you.
    During our tour, we'll also be holding a competition! Defeat the performers and receive a special, bespoke Megamouth Shark Troupe reward for your efforts, as long as you collect it in person.
    Don't miss this amazing opportunity, you might just regret it!

1.Title: Magician Hat
1.Story: Periodically, the Megamouth Shark Troupe will tour the Royal capital Savannah for half a month. These packed tours attract people from all over sending ticket prices skyrocketing. Performances include knife juggling, fire-breathing, trapeze artists and the ever-thrilling Magic Hat trick.

1.Title: Gift Cart
1.Story:
The Megamouth Shark Troupe is Oakenfell's resident Circus Troupe. They hold big performances three times a month and every one is a sell-out show.
    As well as performing in Oakenfell, the Troupe also travels the world putting on shows. The Megamouth Shark Troupe has brought laughter to every corner of Esperia, and the Troupe's Mr Wake has collected innumerable goodies from all over the world.
    Only the Megamouth Shark Troupe's most loyal audience members can redeem the commemorative medal for Mr Wake's exclusive treasure.

1.Title: Treasure Hunt Camp
1.Story:
Still bothered that you can't qualify for the treasure hunters camp?
Upset that you couldn't win the bountiful treasures?
Dismayed that you are ineligible to vie for the title of Treasure Master?

Greetings fellow hunters, If you are doubting whether you have what it takes to be a Treasure Hunter, and at a loss about how to take that first step toward that goal,
let me introduce you to Treasure Hunt Camp––the essential tool for you to become a star hunter!
We will provide you with the necessary training to level you up and set you on the path of becoming a treasure hunter.
Our mentors consist of experienced Treasure Hunters, under whose guidance you will boost your skills in all aspects, including stamina, weaponry, treasure hunting, survival, etc.
Trust me. Once you have attained Treasure Hunter status, all the special training in the Camp will prove invaluable in your future treasure-hunting quests.
If you perform well in the Camp, you will receive an invitation from Treasure Scramble to become a Treasure Hunter.

This is a path of battle and danger. What awaits you may be endless treasures on a vast land, or desolate wilderness that will claim your life.
But fret not and fear not. The Treasure Hunt Camp will be your most trusted guide, leading you on your path to ultimate success and enormous riches!

Alright, I know you're eager to become a Treasure Master.
So what are you waiting for? Join the Treasure Hunt Camp now!

1.Title: Haunting Dreamscape
1.Story:
[Once upon a time, there was a beautiful fairy in the forest. She guarded people in their dreams and made sure all children could sleep soundly...]

"Daddy, the story sounds boring…"

"Alright then. What about the story of Ezizh, the Lord of Nightmares?"

[Once upon a time, there was a terrifying Lord of Nightmares, called Ezizh, that lurked in and swallowed people's dreams. He created terrible nightmares that drove his victims crazy. His many evil deeds drew the attention of the fairy who was the guardian of the dreamland. In order to protect everyone from the villainous Ezizh in their dreams, the fairy would fight him in a fateful battle. But the mighty Lord of Nightmares was too powerful to be defeated by the fairy alone. So she came up with a way to stop him: a dream within dreams.

The clever fairy projected legendary heroes into the dream to trap Ezizh. But he was no easy target to trap! Instead, he decimated the heroes' projections one by one. After all, he hated their bright and glamorous existence. Oh yes, he even swallowed their powers, which they were immensely proud of! The cage forged by the fairy was about to collapse...]

"Daddy, where will the Lord of Nightmares go if he escapes?"

"Shhh… Hush now and sleep, or he'll find you in your dreams."

1.Story:

1.Title: Demonic Puppet
1.Story:
It does not know how it became alive. It just wants to be human without understanding what being a human truly means.

    It stubbornly believes that as long as it replaces its entire body with human parts, including a human heart, that will make it human.

    Unable to find a fit heart, the grotesque puppet can only live on an odd stage, performing weird dances for audiences and watching them lose form and collapse before it. The puppet then dismembers them and affixes their body parts to itself, transforming into a twisted evil puppet.

    "How I wish to be a real human!"

    The puppet looks over its shoulder at the skeletal remains, thinking to itself that to become fully human, it still needs more human parts…

    ...and that these people's deaths must mean it is one step closer to being a human, right?

1.Title: Mythic Prophecy
1.Story:
It is said that this mysterious female stargazer from a distant land can accurately predict the future with her magical abilities.

    Every time a massive event is about to happen in Esperia, she guides you to a place where Fragments of Fate are hidden. Piece them together and they will reveal your imminent fate.

In order to restore the honor of their factions, heroes from across the realm will set out to gather the lost sigils, facing impossible odds and hundreds of pitfalls along the way.

1.Title: Treasure Vanguard
1.Story: After multiple conflicts between treasure hunters, several treasure hunting forces have emerged on the land of Esperia. They have vastly different styles and motives, but are all determined to achieve their goals. Meanwhile, strange movements in the depths of the ancient bay signify new treasures have appeared. This also marks the start of the competition between the treasure hunter factions.

1.Title: The Light Martyr
1.Story:
The Light Martyr was once the most devout disciple of the Divine Light. In its name, she hunted down all things evil at the expense of human compassion.

    Devoted to the Divine Light her entire life, she would destroy anything that attempted to defile her faith without mercy. The irony, however, was that her family then fell into the thrall of black magic. She ought to have slain such evil, even if that meant killing her own kin; yet she was held back by a sliver of compassion. In the end, that led to the demise of several clerics under the blades of the Hypogeans.

    Due to the tragedy, she was convicted of dereliction of her sacred duties and condemned to the darkest dungeons for betraying the Divine Light. Awaiting her was a bloody and barbaric punishment, where she would be locked up in an instrument of torture full of spikes that would however avoid lethal areas of her body.

    When the instrument closed shut, the faint light of her brief life faded off. After giving her whole life to the Divine Light, she could not accept that she would meet such a disgraceful end. Her faith died along with her, and what remained of her former loyalty was nothing but hatred and contempt for the Divine Light.

    From her agonizing death, the once-devout disciple descended into darkness and was reborn as the Light Martyr. A Hypogean consumed by hate, she curses all those protected by the Divine Light with eternal torture and suffering.

1.Title: Chrono Strife
1.Story:
As soon as Orthros had sensed the presence of the alternate timeline, his strategic battle with Zolrath had already begun. One sought to realign destiny and correct its course, while the other aimed to shred the fabric of time, dissolving order with countless divergences and anomalies.
    When the forces of Orthros and Zolrath collided in the depths of time, they tore open a rift that pierced chronology itself, causing a distorted, chaotic realm to take shape—one altogether detached from the normal temporal order. Turbulence in the flow of time rippled out from the rift, drawing some unwitting Esperians into its swirling maw.
    And thus, amidst these disordered threads of time, Orthros and Zolrath fight for control over the alternate timeline. If the cosmos is to heal this rift, one side must win—so everyone must pick a faction.
    The chimes of fate have been struck. You, adventurer! For which side will you fight?

1.Title: The Celestial Isles
1.Story: The strange cubes found upon the celestial isles were created by Ansiel, the Heavenly Crafter. They were used to keep the celestial artifacts from the hands of those with evil intent. Meticulously crafted from ethereal energies made tangible, they are as intricate as they are secure. Each cube consists of multiple parts that twist and rearrange into protective patterns that give way only to a celestial key. Acquiring something so valuable as a celestial key, however, is far from an easy task.

1.Title: Celestial Offerings
1.Story: "If both eyes are veiled by the mist, heed your heart. Allow the will of the gods to guide you to the gifts hidden amongst the stones." —Gretel Hawke, Esperian Records of the Bizarre.

1.Title: The Lost Spire
1.Story:
"People are always keen to share tidings about treasures, as long as they get a share in them."—Guide to Adventure in Esperia

    Legend has it that within the Lightbearer Empire lies an underground spire with secret treasures. The annals of history contain no descriptions of it, hence nothing is known of its origins or how it vanished. It is said that its location has long been deserted, with remnants disclosing no clue of its existence. No one also dares to dig for this secret long buried under this vast land.
    One day, a powerful earthquake ripped the earth's surface and revealed the spire hidden beneath. It was thus that the world had a precious chance to discover more about this unknown underground civilization.
    A shocking revelation is that this lost city that extends downward to a bottomless abyss bears traces of human habitation, in the form of dried bones and skeletons. The spire reeks of a noxious, fetid stench, and so it is impossible to remain there for long. Nevertheless, rumors of hidden treasures have drawn countless adventurers here in droves.
    Those who venture into the spire alone are likely to end up as fresh corpses hanging on the rock walls. Therefore, in order to reach its furthest depths, many have hired mercenaries to join them on their quests. Of course, all this comes at a price.
    As the adventurers explore further, they start to realize that hidden in the underground spire may not be endless treasures after all. Monsters that dwell in the darkness assault them incessantly, and the buried secret begins to resurface...

1.Title: Lost Spire Leaderboard
1.Story:
Adventurers are entering the underground spire with the ultimate aim of finding the treasures hidden on its lowest level. However, lying in wait of these unsuspecting souls are not precious treasures, but frightening monsters lurking in the dark.
    When the underground spire sees the light of day once again, the monsters imprisoned beneath will break free. To keep the monsters from emerging, countless adventurers have attacked them but were unable to decimate them completely. No one knows if the spire's revival signifies destruction, but one thing is for sure––if the creatures are not annihilated, this dark force from underground will devour everything.
    To that end, the Temple of Light has sent a notice to the whole realm, enlisting warriors to destroy the monsters and keep them underground. Adventurers who contribute to the mission will also be awarded the highest honors from the Temple.

1.Title: Starlight at Dawn
1.Story: The Wilders are the closest kin of nature. Any event that impacts the beings in the woods does not escape their attention. When the ominous star falls through the sky, the most powerful among them sense imminent danger. If the evil possesses all souls, a calamity will engulf and destroy the world. In a corner of the realm that is already shrouded by the darkness, a glimmer of starlight is guiding the way to hope.

1.Title: Shining Horizon
1.Story:
As the ominous meteor falls,
Darkness and calamity engulf the Dark Forest.
The Hypogeans trap the lost commander in an illusory realm,
Hell-bent on wearing her will thin and occupying her body.
Yet her bond with her comrades
Lets her see clearly the path she is seeking.
No longer relying on the guidance of the stars,
She resolves to transform into a sharp arrow that pierces through the darkness,
Bringing light back to the Dark Forest.

1.Title: Mirror Demon
1.Story:
According to the legends of Esperia, mirrors reflect the true nature of humanity and non-existent things. This is a tale often told by ignorant humans to fool children, oblivious to mirrors which are ubiquitous in everyday life. People enjoy telling their deepest secrets in front of a mirror, because after all, it carries no trace of their words, or so they think.
    After the mirrors peek into these evil thoughts, the sins of mankind converge in them––and the Mirror Demons are born. As masters of the real and illusory, they are conceived from the ugly souls of those who confess their sins to their reflections. They wander freely through every mirror.
    Constantly, the Mirror Demons gaze into the darkest nature of humans, enticing them to utter despicable words. When the time is right, they devour the reflection in the mirror and replace the person in front of it. In turn, these poor souls are trapped in the mirror void, forever unable to return to reality.
    If you have an evil secret that cannot be shared, please stay silent in front of the mirror. You may not know when you can be replaced by your other "self" in it.

1.Title: Lyrical Exploration
1.Story: The Tulip Poetry Circle is a social group of bards, musicians and other artists located within Oakenfell. The artists in the poetry society would take to the streets from time to time, reciting heroic epics and rural legends, also finding new material and inspirations to compose new poems from those they met on the streets of Oakenfell. Most of the art that the Tulip Poetry Circle create can be traced back to historical deeds that took truly took place.

1.Title: Sky Serpent
1.Story:
A four-footed flying beast that was originally a slave of the pure-blood Dragons, the Sky Serpent knew full well that it was but a wretched and ugly being compared to the noble Dragons. Despite its ability to fly, its tattered wings made it impossible to exhibit the same elegance as the mighty Dragons. In its long years of serving the tribe, the Sky Serpent yearned for the pure-bloods to elevate its lineage and grant it wisdom. However, its wish was crushed by the cruel reality.
    Thwarted in its ambition, the Sky Serpent began secretly studying the Dragons' magic and learning their language, making every effort to imitate their demeanor. It even stole skeletal remains from the Dragon tombs, attempting to wear them. Such actions broke the taboos of the Dragon tribe, and for that the Sky Serpent was permanently exiled. Nonetheless, it still revered the Dragons, even lamenting that it was its ugliness and inferiority that tainted this dignified tribe.
    After the Dragons disappeared without a trace, the Sky Serpent, unable to find its former masters, flew to the Floating Isle that held remnants of the clan's past. To make itself resemble the Dragons, it captured mortals from the ground and enslaved them on the Isle, forcing them to gather Dragon bones and rebuild the former colony. The human slaves suffered great agony, giving their blood, tears, and ultimately lives in this lofty, suffocating prison.
    Having ascended to masterdom from slavery, the Sky Serpent felt an inflated sense of satisfaction. After constantly transforming itself to eventually possess a pseudo-Dragon form, it looted and terrorized mortals at will. The Sky Serpent firmly believes that it can be part of the Dragon tribe as long as it conquers the sky and resembles one of these magnificent beasts; that someday, when the Dragons reappear, they will welcome it into their fold.

1.Title: Raging Cannon
1.Story:
Ever since the mortals possessed firearms, wars have never ceased. Countless souls that perished under merciless gunfire led to the birth of the Raging Cannon, which is unsympathetic about loss of life and desires to visit more destruction on battlefields.
    When a weapon gains an evil mind of its own, it wreaks havoc like a vicious claw from hell. Likewise, the Raging Cannon seeks to turn any battlefield into an inferno, while the Hypogeans, Solhorn and Bihorn, are but its operators that fuel every attack with a glorious blast. Even though each discharge also damages the Cannon itself, it never slows down, intent on destroying more lives with every blaze it ignites.
    The Raging Cannon's ultimate wish is to turn every inch of Esperia into ash, where all beings are engulfed in roaring flames of war, wailing and whimpering until none is left but ashes.
    It believes that eternal war will lay waste to this vast realm, while it—the Raging Cannon—is the true master of gunfire.

1.Title: Nocturnal Whispers
1.Story:
The realm of the dead is never still and silent. On the wastelands of Bantus, over which palls of stifling shadows hang, multiple forces with soaring ambitions, wielding eerie necromancy, seize any opportunity to achieve their goals. With still some days until Noctis Animarum, Ivan became the most trusted official of Thoran. Emboldened by his newfound favor, he grows unrulier by the day and wreaks constant havoc.
    However, Shemira cares not for all this. All she wants is to be by her child's side forever.

1.Title: Elegy's Glow
1.Story:
The anguished mother, having lost everything,
Is finally able to stay with her child forever.
But fate has yet another cruel plan in store for her.
When the child's extraordinary talents catch the eyes of the greedy,
When disaster strikes out of the blue,
And when the most dreadful nightmare recurs…
A mother's heart shall remain staunchly resolute.

1.Story:

1.Title: Mystic Starzone
1.Story:
Lightbearers:
    Constant changes in space and geography are altering the terrain of Esperia. Now, adventurers have once again discovered a new territory for the empire––the Mystic Starzone. This piece of land interacts with the constellations in mysterious ways, and is visited periodically by meteorite rain that carries rare metals. To probe this magnificent location, the empire has authorized you to form teams and compete in mining for Meteorite Gold in the Mystic Starzone, with no holds barred. In turn, the empire will grant you points based on your Meteorite Gold gains and present you with accolades and rewards accordingly.

1.Title: Trails of Mystery
1.Story:
Not long ago, we received a strange commission asking us to investigate recent anomalies in the city. Generally, we do not accept jobs that don't have clear targets. However, this mission came directly from the Bounty Hunters Guild, and we could not reject any instructions from our superiors. So, we had no choice but to start gathering clues everywhere.
 
After investigating for some time, the three of us had a clearer picture of those anomalies. The clues gradually led to the same incident––a mysterious theft. The victims were mostly esteemed heroes, and even stranger were the items they had lost: their abilities which they were proud of.
 
More clues began to surface as the investigation progressed. A mysterious Hypogean had once appeared in the city, and it seemed to have direct or indirect contact with those heroes whose abilities had been stolen. We surmised it was this Hypogean who took the heroes' abilities. If that was the case, then all the odd occurrences would make sense. And we also discovered the final destination of the Hypogean––a mysterious gallery.
 
Thanks to Fawkes and Raine for gathering intel day after day, the facts of the case became clearer. That mysterious Hypogean, whom we called the "curator", was able to steal others' powers and transform them into tangible artifacts to be stored in the gallery. The gallery looked incredibly secretive and menacing, so we dared not make any move before possessing enough intel.
 
Soon enough, we acquired new clues. Someone was able to sneak into the gallery and bring out an artifact. He then successfully released a hero's stolen ability with that artifact. This clue confirmed our previous speculations, shedding light on the truth. We decided to head to the gallery to investigate properly.
 
At that moment, we received news that the heroes whose skills had been stolen had regained their abilities. It appeared that they had not lost their abilities permanently. However, this made us even more curious about the gallery. Based on the latest intel, the artifacts had not disappeared and still remained in the gallery.
 
The curator never appeared, but I could sense that he had been watching all those who were trying to break into the gallery. Perhaps those artifacts were just baits for him to lure people to the gallery and turn them into items of his collection; or perhaps, he was just waiting patiently for us to put up a good show. If you are intrigued to find out about his collection, be forewarned. The Hypogean's intentions are unfathomable, but one thing's for sure––they are malicious.

1.Title: Trails of Mystery
1.Story:
Raine found herself with a rather special bounty from the Bounty Hunters Guild—a mysterious client was looking for a pocket watch. The goal was straightforward, but we had almost no leads. Finding a single watch in a city felt like searching for a needle in a haystack. Luckily, the watch had a unique backstory. After some digging, we discovered it once belonged to a wealthy man who had recently passed away. It was likely now in the hands of his illegitimate child.
 
Once we narrowed things down, we dug deeper. Two clues stood out: the wealthy man had been obsessed with the watch, never letting it out of his sight, and strange noises coming from the cemetery pointed us to its final resting place. The watch was still with the man, buried in his coffin. This wasn't ideal, as convincing the family to disturb his grave would be tough, and stealing it outright wasn't exactly ethical. Stuck in a dead end, we decided to update the client on the watch's location. After all, our job was just to find it. Whether that counted as completing the mission, we weren't sure.
 
But when we told the client, things took a surprising turn. Turns out, the client was the wealthy man's heir! That saved us from any grave-robbing shenanigans. The client was thrilled with our work and promised to pay the rest of the bounty as soon as he had the watch. He even offered us another job, hinting he'd need our help again. This got us curious—why was the heir, who now owned the man's entire fortune, so fixated on this watch? Rumors had it that the wealthy man had discovered a treasure that made him rich, but no one knew where it was. I'd always thought it was just a tall tale, but now it seemed there might be some truth to it.
 
Soon, the client had the watch. His mix of excitement and frustration confirmed our suspicions. Though he never explained why the watch was so important, we were sure it held clues to the man's hidden treasure. The client warily shared some details, asking us to decode the watch's secrets. The clues were slim, but we eventually cracked it. The watch was a specially designed marine chronometer, incredibly precise for long voyages. The inscription inside matched coordinates on a nautical map. The treasure our client was after was hidden somewhere out at sea.
 
I'm guessing the client will gather a crew and set sail soon, but that's no longer our problem. Once he paid us, our job was done. Thanks to your sharp thinking, we wrapped this up smoothly. Don't worry, your cut of the reward is safe!

1.Title: Firefly Glow
1.Story:
Dreamsong Lilies shimmer like stars as they drift to the ground, blown by the soft night breeze. People then gather them and carefully grind the petals to produce a glowing pigment called Luminous Dew. When this pigment is used in artwork, it glows softly at night like fireflies dancing across the sky, producing a starry scene on the canvas.

On Lovepetal Day, people use Luminous Dew to paint images of their loved ones to express their deep affection and heartfelt well-wishes. These artworks represent eternal companionship and protection, like a promise of loving wishes to one another. "Then the petals stream down like glowing fireflies, I will light up the stars of the future for you. May my love ever accompany you, warming your each and every dream."

1.Title: Whispers of Bloom
1.Story:
Once upon a time, a couple who got lost in a forest was guided out by a mythical deer. From then on, the couple enjoyed a life blessed by the gods, and lived happily ever after. Ever since then, this legend gradually evolved into a beautiful holiday: Lovepetal Day.

It is said that if you confess your feelings to your loved one on Lovepetal Day, your passion will receive the blessing of the gods.

As the holiday of happiness and well-wishes approaches, people use Dreamsong Lilies to craft bouquets for their lovers as a symbol of their willingness to listen to each other and protect one another's dreams. The lily's soft whispers seem to tell the hidden truths of one's heart. To give your lover a bouquet of Dreamsong Lilies is to make a promise: "Whether awake or asleep, I will always listen to your heart and guard your dreams."

For this reason, Dreamsong Lilies are seen as a symbol of heart-to-heart communication and a promise of commitment on Lovepetal Day. Countless lovers use them as tokens of love, hoping that their affection may be as precious and long-lasting as the lily itself.

The artists in the poetry society would take to the streets from time to time, reciting heroic epics and rural legends, also finding new material and inspirations to compose new poems from those they met on the streets of Oakenfell. Most of the art that the Tulip Poetry Circle create can be traced back to historical deeds that took truly took place.
