1.Title: Celestial Celebrations
1.Story: Few traces of treasured items left by the deities many ages ago remain, but that does not hamper the joy that ordinary Esperians feel when they embark upon their search for these coveted items. The mortals' creativity has unlimited possibilities. The treasured boxes created by the gods have been gradually dismantled and imitated by mortal craftsmen over many years, giving rise to an annual celebration, an event that many folk look forward to. When autumn arrives in Esperia, it can only mean one thing: the celebration is about to begin. Many folk create their own exquisite treasured boxes and await those who are smart enough to unlock the delights hidden within them. Some folk rejoice in their new findings, others are left empty-handed, sighing with disappointment. But it is precisely this type of anticipation which makes this celebration so special.

1.Title: Plentiful Delights
1.Story: "Esperians place treasures in their treasure boxes, which they open on the day of celebration. Only the wise and the fortuitous can reveal the treasures." -Gretel Hawke, Esperian Delights.

1.Title: Infernal Chasm
1.Story:
As the fabric of time is shredded, the infernal prison of illusion descends. Only the strongest can break free from that false realm.
    This realm is suffused with stifling oppression, where time is fractured and space is warped, making it impossible to tell reality from delusion. Those who enter find themselves trapped in an endless loop of unending tragedy. Only by shattering the illusion and breaking the shackles of fate may one escape this "prison of time".
    Unlocks upon clearing Floor 300 of Temporal Rift.

1.Title: Sealed Pledge
1.Story:
Legend has it that when the Oathbound Camellia withers, its flowers do not crumble into dust, but fall intact, as if delivering their final resolve and dignity together. People say the camellia would rather bid farewell in its complete form than let its sentiments scatter into irretrievable petals. This is its own unique Rite of Guarded Heart.

At dawn, the oath-keepers of the courtyard collect these fallen flowers, immerse the petals in the Temple's holy water for careful extraction, and then brew them with resin to create sealing wax. Once solidified, faint camellia patterns emerge upon the surface, like the imprint of a vow left behind, quiet yet unmistakably clear.

On Lovepetal Day, those who receive camellia bouquets often reciprocate with this solidified wax, writing their feelings into letters and sealing them with promises. Some place it on the letters of travelers, others press it onto the corners of covenant pages, as if telling the other: "May all I promise be fulfilled. May all you cherish be treasured. This vow is sealed, our bond unchanged."

1.Title: Everlasting Vows
1.Story:
Once upon a time, a couple who got lost in a forest was guided out by a mythical deer. From then on, the couple enjoyed a life blessed by the gods and lived happily ever after. Ever since then, this legend gradually evolved into a beautiful holiday: Lovepetal Day.

It is said that if you confess your feelings to your loved one on Lovepetal Day, your passion will receive the blessing of the gods.

Among many bouquets, the Oathbound Camellia that blooms quietly in the depths of courtyards is most cherished by those who value commitment. It doesn't compete with flashy brilliance, yet always stands upright in bloom through wind and snow. When its flowering period ends, rather than withering into the soil, the entire blossom falls with determination, like a silent mark of oath, offering itself to the earth in unwavering devotion from beginning to end.

Thus, people gift Oathbound Camellias to their beloved on Lovepetal Day, both as a solemn declaration of "ideal love" and a gentle promise of "humility and protection": "I vow with my steadfast heart to shield you from life's hardships. Even as seasons change, I wish to remain by your side until our final moment together."

1.Title: Otherworld Fishing
1.Story:
When the sun and moon shine together, a Dimensional Rift where Celestial and Hypogean powers converge silently opens.
Within the rift, Lucilla and Liberta discovered a Void Cocoon, which surprisingly contained an unusual spirit lamb. To keep this fragile being from being consumed by the Dimension, the siblings decided to bring it back and carefully protect it.
However, this spirit lamb showed no response to ordinary things, and its life force grew increasingly faint. Just as they were at a loss, the afterglow of the sun and moon reflected a mysterious sea beside the ruins. The shimmering light on the water's surface faintly resonated with the Void Cocoon, suggesting the presence of strange wonders that could nurture the spirit lamb's growth.
And so, Lucilla and Liberta resolved to join the Adventurer in protecting this Void Cocoon, and to fish for miraculous items in the mysterious sea, all to help this small life from the depths of the rift safely usher in its rebirth...
